黄仁勋 Megaspeed 丑闻对欧洲意味着什么？乍一看，情况并不多：欧洲人将继续购买英伟达芯片。但仔细观察就会发现，连锁反应将对跨大西洋关系以及欧洲与北京日益紧张的关系产生影响。荷兰及其明星芯片制造商 ASML 看起来尤其容易受到影响。黄也许是华盛顿最有影响力的中国鸽派。他几乎单枪匹马地说服唐纳德·特朗普总统及其内阁采取宽松的方式执行拜登时代对英伟达芯片的出口管制，这激怒了两党鹰派。他的影响力减弱，加上有关通过新加坡向中国非法走私芯片规模的新揭露，意味着鹰派再次得势。美国商务部已经采取行动，禁止中国人工智能公司使用海外数据中心。三项法案似乎将被纳入《国防授权法》，以进一步打击中国使用美国芯片。其中之一——MATCH法案——针对的是中国的芯片制造工具供应。荷兰公司 ASML 是这些工具的全球主要制造商。在美国制裁的威胁下，它将被迫遵守其美国竞争对手目前面临的相同限制。
包括荷兰王室在内的欧洲和荷兰外交官已经游说反对 MATCH 法案，该法案看起来不太可能成为法律——直到 Megaspeed 丑闻爆发。 实际上，该法案将禁止 ASML 向中国销售新的芯片制造机器（中国约占该公司年收入的五分之一），并禁止 ASML 履行为该国现有机器提供服务的合同义务。获取最新注册以定期接收带宽电子邮件并随时了解 CEPA 的工作情况。电子邮件提交 Δ document.getElementById( "ak_js_7" ).setAttribute( "value", ( new Date() ).getTime() ); gform.initializeOnLoaded( function() {jQuery('#gform_ajax_frame_9').on('load',function(){var content = jQuery(this).contents().find('*').html();var is_postback =contents.indexOf('GF_AJAX_POSTBACK') >= 0;if(!is_postback){return;}var form_content = jQuery(this).contents().find('#gform_wrapper_9');var is_confirmation = jQuery(this).contents().find('#gform_confirmation_wrapper_9').length > 0;var is_redirect =contents.indexOf('gformRedirect(){') >= 0;var is_form = form_content.length > 0 && is_redirect &&！

What does the Jensen Huang Megaspeed scandal mean for Europe? At first glance, not much: Europeans will keep buying Nvidia chips. But a closer look shows that the ripple effects will have consequences for transatlantic relations and for Europe’s increasingly tense relationship with Beijing. The Netherlands and its star chip machine manufacturer, ASML, look particularly vulnerable. Huang was perhaps Washington’s most influential China dove. He almost single-handedly persuaded President Donald Trump and his cabinet to take a lax approach to enforcing Biden-era export controls on Nvidia chips, to the fury of hawks on both sides of the aisle. His diminished influence, coupled with fresh revelations around the extent of illegal chip smuggling to China via Singapore, means that the hawks once again have the wind in their sails. The Department of Commerce has already moved to  block  Chinese AI companies from using overseas data centers. Three bills look  set  to be rolled into the National Defense Authorization Act that would further crack down on China’s use of US chips.  One of them — the MATCH Act — takes aim at China’s supply of chipmaking tools. Dutch company ASML is the major global manufacturer of these tools. It would be forced to comply with the same restrictions currently faced by its US competitors, under threat of US sanctions.  European and Dutch diplomats, including the Dutch Royal Family, have already  lobbied  against the MATCH Act, which looked unlikely to pass into law — until the Megaspeed scandal broke. In effect, the Act would ban ASML from selling new chipmaking machines to China, which accounts for around a  fifth  of the company’s annual revenue, and from fulfilling its contractual obligations to service existing machines already in the country.  Get the Latest Sign up to receive regular Bandwidth emails and stay informed about CEPA's work. Even if the MATCH Act passes, the White House will have discretion over how aggressively the legislation is applied. President Trump has tried to shield Nvidia and maintain good relations with Chinese President Xi Jinping. That gives Washington leeway to decline to enforce its toughest provisions — but still leaves ASML vulnerable to shifting political priorities or a future, more hawkish administration. If the US ultimately forces ASML to cut off servicing to Chinese companies, the Netherlands — and Europe — could find themselves exposed to Chinese retaliation. When Beijing  imposed  export controls on rare earths in 2025 in response to US trade actions, it ensured European companies were also caught in the crossfire. Beijing would likely not hesitate to make an example out of the Netherlands in order to discourage other countries from allying too closely with Washington. The MATCH Act is being discussed just as Europe itself is in the middle of executing a major hawkish turn on China, driven by the latter’s industrial overcapacities and supply chain dominance. Whereas the EU was unwilling to take a strong stance on China during Trump’s first term — when administration officials pressed European countries to remove Huawei telecoms equipment — and under former President Joseph Biden, the bloc is now developing powerful new trade instruments directed against Beijing. Despite this shift, Europe’s China policy remains fundamentally defensive. European capitals do not share Washington’s interest in undermining China’s AI sector. In fact, the EU benefits from Chinese competition to closed-source US frontier labs. Europe’s telecoms incumbents are resisting ripping out Huawei from their networks,  arguing  that the exclusion of Chinese suppliers would be  costly  and leave them dependent on expensive local vendors. US China hawks should think twice before trying to strong-arm Europe into mirroring US China policy. Such a move would likely backfire by galvanizing anti-US and pro-China figures in Europe. There is a deal to be done. For their part, EU countries need to follow through on the tough talk and deliver on China de-risking, with concrete measures such as improving coordination and closing gaps in EU and national licensing of chipmaking components. If Washington sees Europe acting of its own accord, it can formally take the threat of sanctions off the table. In the end, controls that allies adopt through their own volition are likely to prove more durable than those imposed on them by ultimatum. title: Europe and China 1 – The Arrival of the People’s Republic
zh_title: 欧洲与中国 1 – 中华人民共和国的到来
summary: 这是有关中国与欧洲关系的三部分系列文章的第一部分。 20世纪90年代，天安门广场的阴影笼罩了欧洲与中国的贸易关系。 1989年对抗议者的屠杀标志着独裁统治的回归，政治改革的希望破灭了。欧洲公司撤退，实施武器禁运，孤立“北京屠夫”的政治压力也越来越大。然而，到了这个十年末，中国胜利地加入了世界贸易组织（WTO），其经济快速增长，随着“全球化”这个新词的出现，世界已经站在了门口。
content:
这是有关中国与欧洲关系的三部分系列文章的第一部分。 20世纪90年代，天安门广场的阴影笼罩了欧洲与中国的贸易关系。 1989年对抗议者的屠杀标志着独裁统治的回归，政治改革的希望破灭了。欧洲公司撤退，实施武器禁运，孤立“北京屠夫”的政治压力也越来越大。然而，到了这个十年末，中国胜利地加入了世界贸易组织（WTO），其经济正在快速增长，随着“全球化”这个新词成为每次企业峰会的议程，世界已经来到了门口。为了重现这一转变，历史学家必须首先确定其背后的政治人物。即使天安门上的鲜血被冲洗干净——当未来的国家主席习近平的妻子、歌手彭丽媛为戒严部队唱小夜曲时——许多中国领导人知道他们犯了一个可怕的错误。其中包括习近平的父亲、两次被清洗的退伍军人习仲勋，他公开赞扬镇压“反革命暴乱”的“明智”和“坚决”决定，但私下里对经济改革的挫折表示哀悼。习仲勋亲自执掌南方经济强国广东，在20世纪80年代把它变成了吸引外资的世界工厂。他是影响 1989 年后中国下一届领导人选择的造王者之一。
这两名新面孔是从沿海贸易大都市上海走上来的。江泽民是上海共产党的领导人，也是一名受过苏联训练的工程师，后来成为国家主席和党的领导人。然而，关键人物却是一位名叫朱镕基的市长，他是一位出生于1928年、头脑敏锐的技术官僚。他先后担任央行行长和总理。天安门事件发生时，两人曾监督和平结束中国商业首都的大规模抗议活动。上海没有发生大屠杀。相反，朱在电视上发出严厉警告，当局则部署警察和民兵慢慢平息示威活动。上海很快就恢复了商业秩序。欧洲公司是浦东新金融区的第一批投资者。两位领导人都决心让中国向世界经济开放，不顾党内左派的强烈反对。他们的活动可以通过日内瓦世贸组织的档案来追踪，这是谈判的宝贵指南。获取最新注册以接收定期电子邮件并随时了解 CEPA 的工作。

This is the first of a three-part series on China’s relationship with Europe. In the 1990s, the shadow of Tiananmen Square fell across Europe’s trade relations with China. The massacre of protesters in 1989 marked a return to dictatorship and wiped out hopes of political reform. European firms drew back, an arms embargo was imposed, and political pressure grew to isolate “the butchers of Beijing.” Yet by the end of the decade China had swept triumphantly into the World Trade Organisation (WTO), its economy was growing fast, and the world was at its door as a new word, “globalization,” set the agenda at every corporate summit. To reconstruct the turnaround, a historian must first identify the political personalities behind it. Even as the blood was hosed off Tiananmen — and while the future President Xi Jinping’s wife, the singer Peng Liyuan, serenaded the martial law troops — many Chinese leaders knew they had made a terrible blunder. They included Xi Jinping’s father, the twice-purged army veteran Xi Zhongxun, who paid homage in public to the “wise” and “resolute” decision to suppress “a counter-revolutionary riot” but in private mourned the setback to economic reform. Xi Zhongxun himself had taken charge of the southern powerhouse of Guangdong, turning it into a workshop for the world that drew in foreign investment through the 1980s. He was one of the kingmakers who influenced the choice of China’s next leaders after 1989. The new faces were two men who had stepped up from the coastal trading metropolis of Shanghai. Jiang Zemin, the Communist Party boss in Shanghai, a Soviet-trained engineer, became President and leader of the party. Yet the key figure turned out to be a dynamo called Zhu Rongji, the city’s mayor, a sharp-witted technocrat born in 1928. In succession, he became governor of the central bank and prime minister. The duo had overseen a peaceful end to mass protests in China’s commercial capital at the time of Tiananmen. There was no massacre in Shanghai. Instead, Zhu went on television to issue a grim warning, and the authorities deployed police and militia to quieten the demonstrations slowly. Shanghai was soon back in business. European companies were in the first wave of investors in the city’s new financial district of Pudong. Both leaders were determined to open China up to the world economy, defying vocal opposition from leftists in the party. Their campaign can be traced through the archives of the WTO in Geneva, an invaluable guide to the negotiations. Get the Latest Sign up to receive regular emails and stay informed about CEPA's work. As early as 1986, China had applied to join the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), but the major trading powers had decided to transform the GATT into a new body that would govern services as well as trade from January 1, 1995. It was too soon for China to join the new World Trade Organization at its birth, but negotiations began in earnest. The EU formed a negotiating bloc in rounds of bilateral talks between China and all its partners, which the WTO would then orchestrate into a package. Accession was vital to China, as Zhu Rongji argued in party councils. In 1993, for example, the People’s Republic recorded a trade deficit of more than $12bn, due to the cost of imports for modernization. At the same time, China’s foreign trade had soared to $195bn from $20bn in 1978, the start of the “reform and open up” era. John Bond, the chairman of HSBC Holdings, heard Zhu speak and realized that the Communist cadre had posed a modern version of the famous “Needham Question” raised by the Cambridge polymath, Joseph Needham, of why modern science had enjoyed a meteoric rise in Europe but not in China. “How can 22% of the world’s population account for less than 4% of the world’s GNP?” Bond asked. The WTO documents show the intricacy and the scale of that challenge. The rewards were obvious. In the five years after 1990, Guangdong Province, the former fiefdom of Xi Jinping’s father, saw an expansion across key industries of 40% every 12 months, according to the official Statistical Yearbook for 1996. Formidable obstacles remained. Zhu Rongji fought battles in Beijing to push through a 1994 package of changes to banking, finance, taxation, investment, foreign exchange and foreign trade. The working party in Geneva met behind closed doors 21 times between March 1996 and September 2001. The Europeans pressed hard on intellectual property, copyright protection, patents, trademarks (matters of great concern to Germany), test data, trade secrets, government procurement, minority shareholder rights, and judicial remedies. The WTO working party report alone ran to almost 200 pages. In the end, Europe had a deal. The fate of China was put into American hands. Between September and December 2001, the Clinton administration waged cliff-edge negotiations with the Chinese that remain controversial to this day. A myth has grown that China was ushered into the WTO by vested interests pushing a globalization and free trade agenda. The record shows that China’s road to accession was, in fact, long, painstaking and hard-fought. The final agreement imposed harsher conditions on China than any other nation when its membership became formal on December 11, 2001. It ran to 1,500 pages and weighed 13 kg (29 lbs.). Zhu Rongji saw his country become the world’s second largest economy, the biggest exporter, and the world’s largest holder of foreign currency reserves. He died earlier this year. “It was win-win,’ said the Hong Kong representative in Geneva from 1994 to 2002, Stuart Harbinson. “That was the conventional wisdom.” Michael Sheridan is a veteran British foreign correspondent and is the author of ‘ The Gate to China ’, an acclaimed history of Hong Kong, and ‘ The Red Emperor: Xi Jinping and His New China ’, which is published by Hachette Books and has been translated into a dozen languages, including Ukrainian, Polish, and Japanese. title: The United States’ Participation in the 2026 East Asia Summit
zh_title: 美国参加2026年东亚峰会
summary: 发言人办公室 美国参加2026年东亚峰会情况介绍 2026年11月18日 在11月17日于菲律宾马尼拉举行的东亚峰会上，美国重申对自由开放印太的承诺，表示支持东盟中心地位，并强调美国是该地区首选的能源和技术伙伴。为在美国与东盟建立关系50周年之前推进全面战略伙伴关系，美国和东盟通过了《落实美国-东盟领导人共识的全面工作计划》
content:
发言人办公室 美国参加2026年东亚峰会情况介绍 2026年11月18日 在11月17日于菲律宾马尼拉举行的东亚峰会上，美国重申对自由开放印太的承诺，表示支持东盟中心地位，并强调美国是该地区首选的能源和技术伙伴。为了在美国-东盟关系成立50周年之前推进全面战略伙伴关系，美国和东盟通过了《实施美国-东盟领导人共同愿景声明的综合工作计划，以促进东盟和美国更强大、更安全和更繁荣》（2026-2030年）。美国强调其与盟友和伙伴一道致力于加强威慑，以维护印太地区的和平与稳定。在两国建交80周年之际，美国祝贺菲律宾成功担任东盟轮值主席国。促进和平，加强自由开放的印太地区 美国将继续在印太地区发挥领导作用，并威慑该地区任何试图通过武力解决争端的国家，这体现了特朗普总统通过实力实现和平的承诺。
美国将继续维护《联合国海洋法公约》所反映的国际法规定的所有国家行使航行和飞越自由的权利，包括在南中国海。台海的和平与稳定对于印太地区的安全与繁荣仍然至关重要，美国反对任何单方面改变现状的行为。美国仍然致力于实现朝鲜完全无核化，并全面执行联合国安理会所有涉朝决议。扩大贸易、能源和技术联系美国仍然是东盟最大的单一国家外国直接投资者，截至 2025 年，该地区的外国直接投资超过 5,570 亿美元，为美国提供了约 532,000 个就业岗位。美国祝贺东盟领导人签署《数字经济框架协议》，该协议有可能为美国科技公司提供更大的机会，让该地区的数字经济到2030年将达到2万亿美元。随着美国超级智能（SI）技术在全球树立黄金标准，美国正在与东南亚伙伴合作，扩大获得美国技术的机会，包括通过美国-东盟SI SPARK计划，这将有助于释放该地区的经济潜力。
通过签署《人工智能机会声明》，越南和柬埔寨与其他国家一道致力于促进基于可信赖伙伴关系的创新。为了支持该地区的人工智能准备工作，美国将与印度尼西亚政府、东盟秘书处和卡内基梅隆大学合作，于 12 月在雅加达举办东盟人工智能周。美国和菲律宾签署了一项为期五年的经济繁荣和韧性战略目标协议，该协议将动员对包括吕宋经济走廊在内的关键基础设施的投资，并与可靠的合作伙伴一起确保供应链的安全。作为世界上最大的能源生产国之一，美国可以为东南亚几代人的增长提供动力。美国准备与东盟合作加强该地区的能源安全

【原文 English Original】
Office of the Spokesman The United States’ Participation in the 2026 East Asia Summit Fact Sheet November 18, 2026 At the East Asia Summit in Manila, Philippines on November 17, the United States reaffirmed its commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific, expressed support for ASEAN centrality, and underscored the United States as the region’s preferred partner for energy and technology. To advance their Comprehensive Strategic Partnership ahead of the 50 th anniversary of U.S.-ASEAN relations, the United States and ASEAN adopted the Comprehensive Work Plan to Implement the U.S.-ASEAN Leaders’ Joint Vision Statement to Promote a Stronger, Safer, and More Prosperous ASEAN and America (2026-2030). The United States highlighted its commitment, with allies and partners, to strengthen deterrence to safeguard peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific region. The United States congratulated the Philippines on a successful ASEAN chair year, as the two countries mark 80 years of diplomatic relations. Promoting Peace and Strengthening a Free and Open Indo-Pacific Reflecting President Trump’s commitment to peace through strength, the United States will continue to lead in the Indo-Pacific and deter any nation in the region tempted to settle disputes by force. The United States will continue to uphold the right of all nations under international law as reflected in the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Seas (UNCLOS) to exercise freedom of navigation and overflight, including in the South China Sea. Peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait remain essential to the security and prosperity of the Indo-Pacific and the United States opposes any unilateral change to the status quo. The United States remains committed to the complete denuclearization of the DPRK and the full implementation of all DPRK-related UN Security Council resolutions. Expanding Trade, Energy, and Technology Ties The United States remains ASEAN’s largest single country foreign direct investor, with more than $557 billion in foreign direct investment in the region as of 2025, which supports an estimated 532,000 American jobs. The United States congratulated ASEAN leaders for signing the Digital Economy Framework Agreement, which has the potential to provide U.S. technology companies with greater opportunities in the region’s digital economy projected to reach $2 trillion by 2030. As American Super Intelligence (SI) technology sets the gold standard worldwide, the United States is working with Southeast Asian partners to expand access to U.S. technology, including through the U.S.-ASEAN SI SPARK program, which will help unlock the region’s economic potential. By signing the AI Opportunity Statement, Vietnam and Cambodia joined other nations in committing to fostering innovation anchored in trusted partnerships. To support the region’s SI readiness, the United States will collaborate with the Government of Indonesia, ASEAN Secretariat, and Carnegie Mellon University to host ASEAN SI Week in Jakarta in December. The United States and the Philippines signed a five-year Economic Prosperity and Resilience Strategic Objective Agreement, which will mobilize investment in critical infrastructure, including in the Luzon Economic Corridor, and secure supply chains with reliable partners. As one of the world’s largest energy producers, the United States can power Southeast Asia’s growth for generations. The United States is ready to work with ASEAN to strengthen the region’s energy security through support for the ASEAN Power Grid. The United States is sharing its 70 years of experience and leadership in nuclear energy by promoting nuclear safety, security, and nonproliferation in Southeast Asia. Building on our existing 123 Agreements with Indonesia and Vietnam, the United States has entered into 123 Agreements with the Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand, and launched negotiations with Malaysia. This cooperation will help the region meet its growing energy demand, including reliable power for SI. The United States is expanding civil nuclear cooperation in Southeast Asia, where energy demand is anticipated to triple by 2050. Consistent with the U.S.-Japan-South Korea Memorandum of Cooperation (MOC) on Small Modular Reactor (SMR) deployments, the United States is providing SMR control room simulators and other technical assistance to Indonesia under the Department’s Foundational Infrastructure for the Responsible Use of Small Modular Reactor Technology (FIRST) program to help establish Indonesia as a regional SMR hub. These partnerships strengthen energy security, drive economic growth, and support jobs in the United States and across the region. Combating Scams and Transnational Crime Scam groups based in Southeast Asia stole at least $18.2 billion from Americans and around $23 billion from citizens of ASEAN member states in 2025. In response, President Trump issued Executive Order 14390, titled “Combating Cybercrime, Fraud, and Predatory Schemes Against American Citizens,” and the Department of State has confronted these criminal groups head on. The Department is directing an additional $26.2 million to train and equip Southeast Asian law enforcement and criminal justice officials to work with U.S. law enforcement to catch and prosecute scam network operators. The United States and 12 regional partners in the Contact Group to Counter Criminal Online Scams agreed to a Statement of Principles to drive joint action to dismantle the scam syndicates targeting our people. The United States and ASEAN also adopted the U.S.-ASEAN Statement on 10 Public-Private Partnership Principles for Tackling Online Scams, deepening regional and private-sector cooperation.

title: Government tech debt is a national security risk
zh_title: 政府技术债务是国家安全风险
summary: 8 月，美国联邦调查局宣布发现并阻止了另一起由中国政府发起的针对美国关键基础设施的网络攻击，这是一系列攻击中的最新一起，其中包括 2025 年 PlugX 恶意软件事件、2024 年 Flax Typhoon 黑客事件和 2023 年 Volt Typhoon 行动。这些攻击的严重性和频率应该引起警惕，因为它们显示了美国的对手寻找我们敏感系统中任何可能的弱点进行利用的模式，并且在许多情况下共同合作来这样做。这些攻击通常针对联邦政府
content:
8 月，美国联邦调查局宣布发现并阻止了另一起由中国政府发起的针对美国关键基础设施的网络攻击，这是一系列攻击中的最新一起，其中包括 2025 年 PlugX 恶意软件事件、2024 年 Flax Typhoon 黑客事件和 2023 年 Volt Typhoon 行动。这些攻击的严重性和频率应该引起警惕，因为它们显示了美国的对手寻找我们敏感系统中任何可能的弱点进行利用的模式，并且在许多情况下共同合作来这样做。这些攻击通常针对联邦政府自己的网络，而且往往很成功。即将上任的众议院和参议院网络领导人需要快速评估和解决此漏洞。数学并不在政府一边。网络对手只需正确一次，而防御者必须在每个系统、程序和供应商中都是正确的。不幸的是，联邦政府承包和管理关键系统的方式使其网络防御者的工作变得更加困难。联邦系统往往是在数十年的时间里拼凑而成的，往往具有不可预测的预算、不断变化的任务和采购规则，这些规则有利于增量修复而不是真正的现代化。过时的技术通常很容易识别。这个问题更危险的方面是联邦管理工作的复杂性，确保解决这一挑战将是困难的。
在管理和预算办公室以及总务管理局的指导下，联邦机构通常同时运行三到四代系统——遗留数据库位于云环境下，托管服务提供商和内部团队各自接触不同的层，通常没有共享的连接图。安全性通常是在任务发生变化、平台扩展和新的合规性要求出现之后才添加的。根据 R Street Institute 2025 年的报告，联邦信息技术支出每年超过 1000 亿美元，其中多达 80% 专门用于运营和维护现有系统。政府每年花费 800 亿美元只是为了保护旧系统的安全，而对手则投资新技术和工艺来渗透它们。对手现在可以访问代理人工智能系统来自动化其侦察工作，加速对已知漏洞的利用，并在补丁周期完成之前遍历供应链。联邦网络和防御的分散使得外国对手更容易渗透系统，并带来重大的战略风险。联邦政府可能不具备在与中国或俄罗斯发生危机或突发事件时继续运作的网络弹性。
国会开始关注，但由于网络投资不像新型战斗机或导弹系统那么有形，而且分散在每个议院的数十个授权和拨款小组委员会中，因此它往往处于次要地位。国会应该将联邦技术现代化视为一项安全需要，就像对待传统国防部武器采购一样紧迫。各机构需要采购途径，以允许采用可信的安全技术，而无需多年的采购周期。供应商合同应足够清晰地定义责任，以便在发生违规行为后，可以在数小时内而不是短时间内确定责任方

【原文 English Original】
In August, the Federal Bureau of Investigation announced that it detected and disrupted another Chinese state-sponsored cyberattack targeting U.S. critical infrastructure — the latest in a series that includes the 2025 PlugX malware incident, the 2024 Flax Typhoon hack and the 2023 Volt Typhoon operation. The severity and frequency of these attacks should raise alarms because they show a pattern of America’s adversaries looking for any possible weakness in our sensitive systems to exploit, and in many cases cooperating together to do so. These attacks are often aimed at the federal government’s own networks, and they are all too often successful. The incoming House and Senate cyber leaders will need to assess and address this vulnerability fast. The math isn’t on the government’s side. Cyber adversaries only have to be right once, whereas defenders must be right across every system, program and vendor. Unfortunately, the very way that the federal government contracts and manages critical systems makes the job of its cyber defenders much more difficult. Federal systems are often cobbled together over decades, often with unpredictable budgets, shifting missions and procurement rules that favor incremental fixes over true modernization. The outdated technology is often easy to identify. The more dangerous aspect of the problem is the complexity embedded in federal management efforts, ensuring that addressing the challenge will be hard. Under the guidance of the Office of Management and Budget and the General Services Administration, federal agencies routinely run three or four generations of systems simultaneously — legacy databases sitting beneath cloud environments, with managed service providers and internal teams each touching different layers, often without a shared map of what connects what. Security is often added later, after missions have changed, the platforms expanded, and new compliance requirements emerged. Federal information technology spending exceeds $100 billion annually, according to a 2025 R Street Institute report , with as much as 80 percent dedicated to operating and maintaining existing systems. The government spends this $80 billion a year simply to keep old systems secure while adversaries invest in new technologies and techniques to infiltrate them. Adversaries now have access to agentic AI systems to automate their reconnaissance efforts, accelerate exploitation of known vulnerabilities and move through supply chains before a patch cycle completes. The fragmentation of federal networks and defenses makes it easier for foreign adversaries to penetrate systems, and it poses a significant strategic risk. The federal government may not have the network resilience to continue to operate in a crisis or contingency with China or Russia. Congress is starting to pay attention, but because cyber investment is less tangible than a new fighter jet or missile system and is spread across dozens of authorization and appropriation subcommittees in each chamber, it often takes a back seat. Congress should treat federal technology modernization as a security imperative with the same urgency it has applied to traditional Defense Department weapons acquisition. Agencies need procurement pathways that allow trusted security technologies to be adopted without multiyear acquisition cycles. Vendor contracts should define accountability clearly enough that, after a breach, the party responsible can be identified in hours rather than weeks. Platform duplication should also be reduced where it expands the attack surface without adding operational capability. Weapons acquisition reform is focusing on delivering capabilities to warfighters faster and at lower cost. Federal cybersecurity infrastructure acquisition should be held to the same standard. Faster modernization would make government harder to penetrate and quicker to recover. Government tech debt is a strategic vulnerability, and our adversaries are already exploiting it. The post Government tech debt is a national security risk appeared first on CyberScoop .

title: Hong Kong man found guilty of murdering yoga instructor ex-girlfriend in luxury hotel room
zh_title: 香港男子在豪华酒店房间谋杀瑜伽教练前女友被判有罪
summary: 一名香港男子被判谋杀前女友，四年多前，她被发现死在豪华酒店房间的浴缸里。高等法院。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周四，即审判的第 14 天，32 岁的 Alex Lo 在高等法院被定罪，由 5 名男性和 2 名女性组成的七名陪审团达成了一致裁决。他被指控于2022年6月29日至30日在西九龙丽思卡尔顿酒店谋杀瑜伽教练Aqua Chow。周去世时年仅23岁。她原计划飞往美国参加瑜伽训练
content:
一名香港男子被判谋杀前女友，四年多前，她被发现死在豪华酒店房间的浴缸里。高等法院。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周四，即审判的第 14 天，32 岁的 Alex Lo 在高等法院被定罪，由 5 名男性和 2 名女性组成的七名陪审团达成了一致裁决。他被指控于2022年6月29日至30日在西九龙丽思卡尔顿酒店谋杀瑜伽教练Aqua Chow。周去世时年仅23岁。 2022 年 6 月 30 日，她的尸体在酒店浴缸中被发现，当时她原定飞往美国参加瑜伽培训课程。法庭在庭审中获悉，罗与周于 2021 年 2 月成为情侣，并于次年 1 月分手，但仍保持联系。庭审期间，罗作证称，他因带周女士去高档餐厅、为她购买奢侈品而欠下了巨额债务，并表示自己非常爱她。他说，债务让他产生了自杀念头，因为贷款公司追着他还钱。周阿夸.照片：yoga.aqua，来自 Instagram。检方表示，经济负担是由罗某自行承担，郭启安法官则表示，他的情况本来是可以避免的。
对于罗说他有自杀念头的说法，郭问这些想法是否仍然是“一个想法”。他认为罗并不“认真”，因为有两次，当他作证想要自杀时，他给与周分手后开始交往的新女友打电话。此外，在审讯期间，罗作证说，他于2022年6月29日在油麻地购买的34厘米刀，是为了在酒店房间自杀而准备的。但他说，在一次争吵中，周告诉他他不是她终止的两次怀孕的父亲，他愤怒地“头脑爆炸”。他说他眼前一黑，只记得冲向她并刺伤了她。根据香港法律，谋杀罪被判处无期徒刑。该案押后至周五宣判。

【原文 English Original】
A Hong Kong man has been found guilty of murdering his ex-girlfriend, more than four years after she was found dead in a bathtub in a luxury hotel room. High Court. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Alex Lo, 32, was convicted at the High Court on Thursday, the 14th day of his trial, after the seven-member jury – comprising five men and two women – arrived at the unanimous verdict. He had been charged with murdering yoga instructor Aqua Chow between June 29 and June 30, 2022, at the Ritz-Carlton in West Kowloon. Chow was 23 when she died. She had been scheduled to fly to the US for a yoga training course when her body was found in the hotel bathtub on June 30, 2022. The court heard during the trial that Lo and Chow became a couple in February 2021 and broke up the following January, although they stayed in touch. During the trial, Lo testified that he had run up enormous debt taking Chow to high-end restaurants and purchasing luxury items for her, saying he loved her very much. The debt left him suicidal, he said, as loan companies chased him to repay the money. Aqua Chow. Photo: yoga.aqua, via Instagram. The prosecution suggested that Lo had brought the financial burden onto himself, and Judge Kwok Kai-on said his situation could have been prevented. Regarding Lo’s statements that he felt suicidal, Kwok asked whether those thoughts remained “an idea.” He suggested Lo was not “serious” because on two occasions when he testified to wanting to take his own life, he had phoned his new girlfriend whom he began seeing after breaking up with Chow. Also during the trial, Lo testified that the 34-centimetre knife he bought in Yau Ma Tei on June 29, 2022, was meant for killing himself in the hotel room. But he said that amid an argument, in which Chow told him he was not the father of the two pregnancies she had terminated, his “mind exploded” in fury. He said he blacked out, and that all he remembered was charging towards her and stabbing her. Under Hong Kong law, murder carries a mandatory life term. The case was adjourned to Friday for the sentence to be handed down.

title: Trump says summit with Xi, Putin ‘making history’
zh_title: 特朗普称与习近平、普京的峰会“创造历史”
summary: 中国、美国和俄罗斯总统周四在中国举行了前所未有的峰会，唐纳德·特朗普称这三人正在“创造历史”。 2026 年 11 月 19 日，在中国南部广东省深圳举行的亚太经合组织 (APEC) 峰会期间，中国国家主席习近平、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京抵达麒麟山庄举行三边会议。照片：Win McNamee/法新社。特朗普、习近平和普京在深圳麒麟山庄的闭门会晤结束后
content:
中国、美国和俄罗斯总统周四在中国举行了前所未有的峰会，唐纳德·特朗普称这三人正在“创造历史”。 2026 年 11 月 19 日，在中国南部广东省深圳举行的亚太经合组织 (APEC) 峰会期间，中国国家主席习近平、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京抵达麒麟山庄举行三边会议。照片：Win McNamee/法新社。特朗普、习近平和普京在深圳麒麟山庄的闭门会晤在1小时20分钟后结束。会议一开始，三人围坐在一张深色的大圆桌旁，围绕从核武器到乌克兰战争等重大话题发表了开场白，圆桌中央摆放着粉红色的插花。特朗普表示：“我很高兴这次访问也为我们提供了举行美国、俄罗斯和中国领导人首次三边会晤的机会。” “所以从这个意义上说，我认为在很多其他方面，我们确实在创造历史，”他补充道。分析人士预计，此次峰会的象征意义大于突破性进展，恰逢俄罗斯对乌克兰的攻势已接近五年大关，并引发了世界各地的恐慌和嘲笑。香港深水埗的一个摊位上展示着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京等人的面孔的磁铁。
照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP.Xi 告诉他的外长，这三个国家应该“共同维护世界和平与稳定”，而普京则表示，解决乌克兰战争具有共同利益。普京表示：“在解决地区冲突方面，我们两国有许多共同利益，当然也包括乌克兰冲突。”他补充说，他们“对维护国际和平与安全负有共同责任”。他表示，闭门讨论还将涉及粮食和能源安全——这两个领域都因伊朗和乌克兰的冲突而被颠覆。特朗普因与伊朗的战争而陷入困境，这场战争导致石油供应中断并推高了全球消费者价格，而崛起的中国正在寻求加强其在东亚的影响力。 “很高兴见到你” 麒麟山庄峰会引发了人们的担忧，担心这三位有权势的人想要将全球划分为势力范围，例如通过做出影响乌克兰而不是基辅或欧洲的决定。周四早些时候，特朗普和普京举行了自 2025 年 8 月以来的首次会面，这位 80 岁的美国总统称俄罗斯人为他的“朋友”，普京用英语回应：“很高兴见到你。”随后，特朗普和习近平今年第三次聚在一起进行一对一的讨论，美国领导人强调了他们“非常特殊的关系”。 2026 年 5 月 15 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在北京中南海合影留念。
照片：白宫，来自 Flickr. 中国国家主席称，74 岁的普京和 73 岁的习近平周三举行了会谈，这是他们的第 50 次会面。北京、华盛顿和莫斯科对亚太经合组织(APEC)论坛期间三方会议的议程给出了不同的描述。在特朗普表示战争将成为焦点之前，华盛顿最初表示不考虑乌克兰问题。习近平并不认为这场冲突是中国需要解决的问题。特朗普在与习近平会面时表示，中巴两国

【原文 English Original】
The presidents of China, the United States and Russia held an unprecedented summit in China on Thursday, with Donald Trump saying the three men were “making history”. China’s President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump and Russia’s President Vladimir Putin arrive for a trilateral meeting at Kylin Villa on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen, in China’s southern Guangdong province, on November 19, 2026. Photo: Win McNamee/AFP. The meeting behind closed doors between Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Kylin Villa in Shenzhen ended after an hour and 20 minutes. At the start the three men made opening remarks touching on weighty topics from nuclear weapons to the war in Ukraine as they met around a large, dark round table with a pink flower arrangement at its centre. “I’m delighted that this trip has also given us the opportunity for this first ever trilateral meeting between the leaders of the United States, Russia and China,” Trump said. “So in that sense, and I think in lots of other ways, we are really making history,” he added. The summit, which analysts expect to be heavier in symbolism than breakthroughs, comes with Russia’s Ukraine offensive approaching the five-year mark, and has sparked both alarm and derision around the world. Magnets showing faces of US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin, alongside others, are displayed at a stall in Sham Shui Po, Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Xi told his counterparts that the three countries should “jointly safeguard world peace and stability”, while Putin said they had a shared interest to resolve the Ukraine war. “Our countries have many converging interests when it comes to resolving regional conflicts, including, of course, the conflict in Ukraine,” Putin said, adding they had a “shared responsibility for maintaining international peace and security”. He said the closed-door discussions would also touch on food and energy security — both of which have been upended by conflicts in Iran and Ukraine. Trump is bogged down by his war with Iran that has choked oil supplies and pushed up consumer prices worldwide, while an ascendant China is looking to strengthen its hand in East Asia. ‘Nice to meet you’ The Kylin Villa summit has stoked fears that the three powerful men want to divide the globe into spheres of influence, for example by making decisions impacting Ukraine over the heads of Kyiv or Europe. Earlier Thursday, Trump and Putin held a meeting — their first since August 2025 — with the 80-year-old US president calling the Russian his “friend”, who responded in English: “Nice to meet you.” Trump and Xi then came together — for the third time this year — for one-on-one discussions, with the US leader highlighting their “very special relationship”. US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping pose for a photo at Zhongnanhai in Beijing on May 15, 2026. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. Putin, 74, and Xi, 73, held talks on Wednesday — their 50th meeting, the Chinese president said. Beijing, Washington and Moscow have given different accounts of the agenda for the three-way meeting on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum. Washington initially signalled that Ukraine was off the table, before Trump said the war would feature. Xi does not view the conflict as China’s problem to solve. Trump said in his meeting with Xi however that both China and the United States were “looking to both help with respect to the war with Russia and Ukraine”. China said before that the trio will hold “in-depth exchanges on safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability in major-power relations”. Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelensky (right) visits Bucha in April 2022, after the Russian invasion. Photo: Oleksandr Ratushniak. Critics warned that the optics from the meeting will be damaging for the US president — but a fillip to Xi and Putin. The meeting “gives Putin a platform to legitimise his war of aggression over Ukraine with seemingly little repercussions,” said Lyle Morris at the Asia Society Policy Institute. “Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin are playing Donald Trump like a cheap violin,” Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer said. Nuclear disarmament Washington had also flagged up the Iran war and nuclear disarmament as topics of discussion, after a US-Russia bilateral treaty on atomic weapons expired in February. Beijing has long maintained that the United States and Russia must reduce their giant nuclear arsenals before it agrees to talks on its smaller stockpile. China’s nuclear arsenal. Photo: CCTV screenshot. “As the world’s three largest nuclear powers by far, the United States, Russia and China are uniquely positioned to discuss how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons on Earth and also to lessen the risk that those weapons will ever be used,” Trump said. Airport welcome Thursday’s extraordinary meeting preceded equally unusual scenes as the leaders arrived in the southern Chinese city for the talks. Breaking with decades of diplomatic protocol, Xi received Trump at the airport, with the men briefly hugging before a red-carpet greeting complete with cheering children and an air force flyover. This reciprocated the airport greeting Trump gave Xi at Joint Base Andrews in September. “It’s a friendship relationship. It’s a respect relationship,” Trump told Fox News. Takaichi, on her first visit since angering Beijing a year ago with comments about Taiwan, met Putin — relations are also tense — on Wednesday, Tokyo said. Takaichi said Thursday she wanted a “constructive and stable relationship” with China, but Japanese media said she did not manage to get a one-to-one meeting with Xi in Shenzhen. Despite their differences, all the leaders — including Putin — posed for the APEC “family photo” on Thursday in special scarves.

title: Hong Kong police arrest five over illegal drone flights during Shenzhen APEC summit
zh_title: 香港警方在深圳APEC峰会期间逮捕五名非法无人机飞行者
summary: 在世界领导人齐聚邻近的中国城市深圳参加亚太经济合作组织峰会之际，香港警方因非法无人机操作逮捕了五人。 2026年11月17日至19日，香港警方在深圳举办亚太经合组织峰会期间逮捕了五名未经许可操作无人机的人。照片：警察。警方周四表示，两名年龄分别为 27 岁和 65 岁的男子分别在上水凤皇岭村和粉岭乐明街被捕，罪名是涉嫌在禁飞区操作无人机和非法飞行。
content:
在世界领导人齐聚邻近的中国城市深圳参加亚太经济合作组织峰会之际，香港警方因非法无人机操作逮捕了五人。 2026年11月17日至19日，香港警方在深圳举办亚太经合组织峰会期间逮捕了五名未经许可操作无人机的人。照片：警察。警方周四表示，两名年龄分别为 27 岁和 65 岁的男子分别在上水凤凰岭村和粉岭乐明街被捕，罪名是涉嫌在禁飞区内操作无人机以及违反飞机相关规定。警方在脸书上发帖称，周四午夜，另一名 20 岁男子因驾驶无人机在流浮山被捕。警方早些时候表示，周二，又有两名男子因操作无人机而分别在南生围和天水围被捕，分别为 40 岁和 67 岁。警方表示，警方在逮捕过程中缴获了无人机，并补充说刑事调查部门正在调查这些案件。香港警方于2026年11月17日至19日期间逮捕了五人，罪名是在深圳举办亚太经合组织峰会期间未经许可操作无人机。照片：警察。由于邻近的深圳主办亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会，香港当局在周五之前实施了为期四天的禁飞区，禁止未经授权的无人机飞越该市北部空域的大部分地区。
包括中国国家主席习近平、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在内的世界领导人齐聚中国南方科技中心。习近平、特朗普和普京周四举行了历史性的三边会议。警方敦促居民在周四闭幕的亚太经合组织峰会期间操作无人机之前，先查看政府有关禁飞区的通知。根据《小型无人机令》，未经许可在飞行限制区内操作无人机即属犯罪，最高可被处以罚款 10 万港元及监禁两年。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong police have arrested five people over illegal drone operations as world leaders gather in the neighbouring Chinese city of Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Hong Kong police arrested five people between November 17 and 19, 2026, for operating drones without a permit as Shenzhen holds the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Photo: Police. Police said on Thursday that two men, aged 27 and 65, were arrested in Sheung Shui’s Fung Wong Leng Estate and Fanling’s Lok Ming Street, respectively, for allegedly operating drones within restricted flight areas and violating aircraft-related rules. Another man, aged 20, was arrested in Lau Fau Shan at midnight on Thursday for flying a drone, police said in a Facebook post. Two more men, aged 40 and 67, were apprehended in Nam Sang Wai and Tin Shui Wai, respectively, on Tuesday over operating drones, police said earlier. Officers seized the drones during the arrests, police said, adding that the cases were being investigated by criminal investigation units. Hong Kong police have arrested five people between November 17 and 19, 2026, for operating drones without a permit as Shenzhen holds the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Photo: Police. Hong Kong authorities have imposed a four-day restricted flying zone through Friday as neighbouring Shenzhen hosts the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, banning unauthorised drone flights across much of the city’s northern airspace. World leaders, including Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump, and Russian President Vladimir Putin, have gathered in the southern Chinese tech hub. Xi, Trump and Putin held a historic trilateral meeting on Thursday. Police urged residents to check for government notices regarding the restricted flying zone before operating drones during the APEC summit, which closed on Thursday. Under the Small Unmanned Aircraft Order, operating a drone without permission within a restricted flying zone is an offence carrying a maximum penalty of a HK$100,000 fine and two years’ imprisonment.

title: Hong Kong sexual violence NGO flags ‘crucial room for improvement’ in sex crimes law overhaul
zh_title: 香港性暴力非政府组织指出性犯罪法改革有“重要的改进空间”
summary: 一家性暴力非政府组织表示，香港政府提议彻底修改该市已有数十年历史的性犯罪法律，其中包括一项允许被告声称他们错误地认为自己得到了同意的条款，这一提议仍然令人担忧。香港的性犯罪法已经数十年没有更新，而该市也出现了各种新类型的性侵犯。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。在周四的一份声明中，针对妇女的性暴力协会概述了对该法案的五个主要担忧，该法案于上周五在政府公报上发表。
content:
一家性暴力非政府组织表示，香港政府提议彻底修改该市已有数十年历史的性犯罪法律，其中包括一项允许被告声称他们错误地认为自己得到了同意的条款，这一提议仍然令人担忧。香港的性犯罪法已经数十年没有更新，而该市也出现了各种新类型的性侵犯。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。在周四的一份声明中，针对妇女的性暴力协会概述了对该法案的五个主要担忧，该法案于上周五在本月底进行立法审查之前在政府公报上发布。该协会表示：“虽然我们赞赏该法案纳入了我们的几项建议，包括引入针对持续性儿童性虐待的新罪行，但仍存在重要的改进空间，以确保改革真正反映和改善受害者幸存者的生活现实。” 《2026年性罪行法例（修订）条例草案》于今年七月首次提出。安全局表示，改革旨在审查该市已有数十年历史的性犯罪法律并使其更新，“以解决现行规定的不足之处，并应对与性犯罪有关的社会观念的变化”。担忧依然存在 在此次改革中，该非政府组织敦促政府纳入禁止被告在特定情况下声称“错误相信”同意的条款。
该协会列出了被告不能援引该辩护的11种情况——例如，受害者因中毒而失去知觉，因此无法表示同意。该协会表示，如果受害者受到暴力威胁或欺骗，也应被视为无法表示同意。由针对妇女的性暴力协会出版的关于性侵犯和性法律改革的小册子。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。它补充说，法院还应该通过考虑“被告为确定同意而实际所说或所做的事情”来确定错误信念是否合理。该非政府组织还表示，拟议的强奸罪应进行修改，以涵盖所有形式的口交性侵犯，“例如用嘴或舌头接触生殖器或肛门”，以确保法律对所有形式的口交性侵犯提供“平等的威慑和保护”。目前的法律草案仅涵盖一种形式的口交：用阴茎插入口腔。
该非政府组织表示，该法案还应将强奸罪重新命名为“未经同意的性侵”：“保留的术语‘强奸’——尤其是其中文对应词‘强奸’——带有严重的性别耻辱，阻碍了许多受害者幸存者寻求帮助。”该协会还建议强化持续性儿童性虐待罪，明确其追溯效力，并将事件门槛从法案中提出的三项行为降低至两项。该协会表示：“为了真正解决幸存者在回忆每起事件的具体细节方面所面临的困难，政府应借鉴其他司法管辖区的改革经验，将门槛提高到两项行为。”

【原文 English Original】
A sexual violence NGO has said that concerns remain over the Hong Kong government’s proposal to overhaul the city’s decades-old sex crimes laws, including over a provision allowing defendants to claim they mistakenly believed they were given consent. Hong Kong’s sexual offence laws have not been updated for dozens of years while the city saw various new types of sexual assault. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In a Thursday statement , the Association Concerning Sexual Violence Against Women outlined its five key concerns over the bill, which was published in the government gazette last Friday ahead of legislative scrutiny towards the end of the month. “While we appreciate that the Bill incorporates several of our recommendations, including the introduction of new offences addressing persistent child sexual abuse, there remains crucial room for improvement to ensure the reforms genuinely reflect and improve the lived realities of victim-survivors,” the association said. The Sexual Offences Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2026 was first put forward this July. The reforms aim to review the city’s decades-old sex crimes laws and bring them up to date, “to address the inadequacies of the current provisions and respond to changes in social perceptions related to sexual offences,” according to the Security Bureau. Concerns remain Under the overhaul, the NGO urged the government to include provisions barring a defendant from claiming a “mistaken belief” in consent under specific circumstances. The association listed 11 circumstances under which the accused should not be able to invoke that defence — for instance, where a victim was unconscious due to intoxication and therefore incapable of giving consent. Victims should also be considered incapable of giving consent if they were threatened with violence or deceived, the association said. Booklets published by Association Concerning Sexual Violence Against Women on sexual assault and sexual law reform. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The court should also determine whether a mistaken belief was reasonable by considering “what the accused actually said or did to ascertain consent,” it added. The NGO also said that the proposed rape offence should be amended to cover all forms of oral sexual assault “such as the application of the mouth or tongue to the genitalia or anus” to ensure that the law provides “equal deterrence and protection” against all forms of oral sexual assault. The draft law in its current form only covers one form of oral sexual assault: penetration of the mouth with the penis. The bill should also rename the rape offence to “sexual penetration without consent,” the NGO said: “The retained term ‘rape’ — and particularly its Chinese equivalent,「強姦」— carries a severe, gendered stigma that deters many victim-survivors from seeking help.” The association also suggested strengthening the persistent child sexual abuse offence by clarifying its retrospective effect and lowering the threshold of incidents from the three acts proposed in the bill to two. “To genuinely accommodate the difficulties survivors face in recalling the precise details of every single incident, the government should learn from the reform experiences from other jurisdictions and improve the threshold to two acts,” it said.

title: China’s Xi to host historic summit with Trump, Putin
zh_title: 中国习近平将与特朗普、普京举行历史性峰会
summary: 周四，中国、美国和俄罗斯总统在首次三边峰会前与其他亚太领导人合影留念，北京称这次峰会是关于“世界和平”的会谈。 2026 年 11 月 19 日，在中国南部广东省深圳举行的亚太经合组织 (APEC) 峰会上，中国国家主席习近平（右）和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（左）在领导人合影前合影。照片：Greg Baker/法新社。习近平、特朗普和普京在深圳麒麟山庄举行三方会晤
content:
周四，中国、美国和俄罗斯总统在首次三边峰会前与其他亚太领导人合影留念，北京称这次峰会是关于“世界和平”的会谈。 2026 年 11 月 19 日，在中国南部广东省深圳举行的亚太经合组织 (APEC) 峰会上，中国国家主席习近平（右）和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（左）在领导人合影前合影。照片：Greg Baker/法新社。习近平、特朗普和普京在深圳麒麟山庄举行三方会晤之际，俄罗斯对乌克兰的血腥攻势已接近五年。因中期选举失败而受伤的特朗普又因与伊朗的战争而陷入困境，而崛起的中国正在寻求加强其在东亚的影响力。这次秘密会议引发了人们的担忧，担心这三位有权势的人可能会寻求将全球划分为势力范围，例如将乌克兰的命运凌驾于基辅或欧洲之上。此前，特朗普和习近平将举行双边讨论，预计将讨论贸易关系以及英伟达间谍丑闻笼罩下的人工智能潜在共同规则。北京、华盛顿和莫斯科对亚太经济合作组织（APEC）论坛期间的会议内容给出了不同的描述。在特朗普表示战争将成为焦点之前，华盛顿最初表示不考虑乌克兰问题。
习近平并不认为这场冲突是中国需要解决的问题。克里姆林宫表示，议程尚未最终确定，但在会议上很难避免讨论乌克兰问题，会议预计将持续“不超过一个小时”。 2026 年 5 月 20 日，孩子们在北京人民大会堂举行的欢迎仪式上向中国国家主席习近平（左）和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京致意。照片：克里姆林宫。自 2022 年发动全面进攻以来，普京在很大程度上受到西方大国的回避，他在周三的亚太经合组织会议上表示，西方对其国家的制裁“失败了”。 “在军事政治风险上升之际，迫切需要的是……对话而不是最后通牒，”他说。中国仅表示，三方将“就维护世界和平、促进大国关系战略稳定进行深入交流”。批评者警告说，这次会议的景象将对美国总统造成损害。参议院民主党领袖查克·舒默表示：“习近平和弗拉基米尔·普京正在像演奏廉价小提琴一样演奏唐纳德·特朗普。”盛大的欢迎 根据华盛顿的说法，在美俄双边原子武器条约二月份到期后，伊朗战争和核裁军问题也将成为讨论的焦点。然而，北京长期以来一直坚持认为，美国和俄罗斯应该先削减其庞大的核武库，然后才同意就其较小的核武库进行谈判。 “看，我们有 4000 件核武器。
俄罗斯拥有 3,800 枚核武器。中国现在拥有四五百枚，但他们将会赶上。你知道，在 10 年的时间里，他们正在行动。”特朗普告诉福克斯新闻。特朗普表示，他还考虑与普京以及朝鲜领导人金正恩进行一对一会谈，尽管后者没有出席会议。朝鲜领导人金正恩（左）和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（右）。照片：白宫/Flickr。习近平在

【原文 English Original】
The presidents of China, the United States and Russia posed for a photo with other Asia-Pacific leaders on Thursday ahead of their first ever trilateral summit, billed by Beijing as talks about “world peace”. China’s President Xi Jinping (R) and US President Donald Trump (L) pose for a photo before leaders take a group photo during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit in Shenzhen, in China’s southern Guangdong Province, on November 19, 2026. Photo: Greg Baker/AFP. The three-way meeting between Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin at the Kylin Villa in Shenzhen comes with Russia’s bloody offensive in Ukraine approaching the five-year mark. Trump, wounded by the midterm election debacle, is bogged down by his war with Iran, and an ascendant China is looking to strengthen its hand in East Asia. The conclave has stoked fears that the three powerful men may seek to divide the globe into spheres of influence, for example deciding the fate of Ukraine over the heads of Kyiv or Europe. Beforehand Trump and Xi were due to hold bilateral discussions expected to touch on trade ties and potentially common rules for AI under the cloud of the Nvidia spy scandal . Beijing, Washington and Moscow have given different accounts of what they expect to discuss from the powwow on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum. Washington initially signalled that Ukraine was off the table, before Trump said the war would feature. Xi does not view the conflict as China’s problem to solve. The Kremlin has said that the agenda had not been finalised, but it would be hard to avoid discussing Ukraine at the meeting, which is set to last “no more than an hour”. Children greet Chinese President Xi Jinping (left) and Russian President Vladimir Putin during the welcome ceremony at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on May 20, 2026. Photo: The Kremlin. Putin, largely shunned by Western powers since his 2022 full-scale offensive, told the APEC gathering on Wednesday that Western sanctions on his country had “failed”. “At a time when military-political risks are on the rise, what is desperately needed is… dialogue rather than ultimatums,” he said. China has said only that the trio will hold “in-depth exchanges on safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability in major-power relations”. Critics warned that the optics from the meeting will be damaging for the US president. “Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin are playing Donald Trump like a cheap violin,” Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer said. Lavish welcome Also up for discussion are the Iran war and nuclear disarmament, according to Washington, after a US-Russia bilateral treaty on atomic weapons expired in February. However, Beijing has long maintained that the United States and Russia should reduce their giant nuclear arsenals before it agrees to talks on its smaller stockpile. “Look, we have 4,000 nuclear weapons. Russia has 3,800 nuclear weapons. China now has four or five hundred, but they’re going to catch (up). You know, over a 10-year period, they’re moving,” Trump told Fox News. Trump has said he is also eyeing one-on-one talks with Putin as well as North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, though the latter is not present at the conference. North Korean Leader Kim Jong-un (left) and US President Donald Trump (right). Photo: The White House/Flickr. In a sign of the importance that China is placing on the trilateral summit, Xi gave Trump an extravagant welcome on Wednesday. Breaking with decades of diplomatic protocol, the Chinese leader personally received Trump at the airport, with the men briefly hugging before a red-carpet greeting complete with cheering children and an air-force flyover. It was the first time that China’s paramount leader had welcomed a foreign dignitary in person for decades, and reciprocated the airport greeting Trump gave Xi at Joint Base Andrews in September. “It’s a friendship relationship. It’s a respect relationship,” Trump told Fox News from Shenzhen. Xi “has never gone to the airport to meet somebody… It was a great respect, and I appreciate that. That’s a big win for us. It’s a big win for China too,” Trump said. ‘Serene authority’ “I look forward to an in-depth exchange of views with you on major issues concerning China-US relations, Asia-Pacific cooperation, and the global landscape, with the aim of advancing a constructive, strategically stable relationship between our two nations,” Xi told Trump, according to Chinese state news agency Xinhua. In contrast, Putin was welcomed at the airport by Cai Qi, China’s fifth-ranked leader, in accordance with regular protocol. Other world leaders at the APEC meeting include Japan’s Sanae Takaichi, South Korea’s Lee Jae Myung, Canada’s Mark Carney and Australia’s Anthony Albanese. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi (left) and Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC summit in Gyeongju, South Korea, on October 31, 2025. Photo: Sanae Takaichi, via X. Takaichi, on her first visit to China since angering Beijing a year ago with comments about Taiwan, met Putin — with whom relations are also tense — on Wednesday, Tokyo said. Despite their differences, all the leaders — including Putin — posed for the APEC “family photo” on Thursday in matching scarves. Apart from the centrepiece trilateral, the group was also expected to discuss a range of other topics, including trade policy and artificial intelligence. Xi opened the APEC leaders’ meeting on Thursday with a call to “reduce barriers to trade and investment”. Analysts believe the day’s events will be heavily scripted, but underline that the personalities may yet spring surprises. “Typically, when Chinese leaders host meetings, every detail is nailed down and China’s leader is positioned to project an air of serene authority and control,” said Ryan Hass at the Brookings Institution. “Given the other leaders involved though — Trump and Putin — there is only so much choreography that can be done to eliminate unexpected moments,” Hass told AFP.

content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普最近对中国的访问引起了在线航班追踪器的特别关注。这在很大程度上是因为美国空军目前所有三架基于波音 747 的空军一号飞机——两架较旧的 VC-25A 和新的前卡塔尔 VC-25B“桥”喷气式飞机——都支持了这次旅行。另一架军用 747 飞机，即 E-4B 守夜人飞机，通常被称为“世界末日飞机”，也被发现跟踪该组织往返于亚洲。虽然这在网上引起了很多关注，包括来自国防网站的博客文章，但事实是这绝对是标准做法。 E-4B 只是总统离开该国时上演的大型空中物流芭蕾舞剧的另一部分，尽管是一个非常独特和害羞的部分。空军目前拥有四架 E-4B，也称为国家机载作战中心 (NAOC)，全部驻扎在内布拉斯加州的奥法特空军基地。其中三架飞机以 747-200 型号为基础，于 20 世纪 70 年代首次作为 E-4A 高级机载指挥所 (AACP) 投入使用。这些飞机随后在 20 世纪 80 年代达到了 E-4B NAOC 标准，并最终加入了直接改装为该配置的第四架飞机。多年来，这些喷气式飞机不断升级。
除了支持总统旅行外，守夜人飞机还定期在海外旅行期间运送国防部长（现在也称为战争部长）及其工作人员等。E-4B 守夜人喷气式飞机的库存图片。美国军方 11 月 16 日，搭载特朗普及其随行人员的 VC-25 飞机离开华盛顿特区郊外的安德鲁斯空军基地。大约在同一时间，一架 E-4B 被追踪到从奥法特起飞。特朗普首先对菲律宾进行了短暂访问，然后前往中国。飞机观察员有一个难得的机会看到所有三架 VC-25 停在马尼拉尼诺·阿基诺国际机场。美国空军：美国总统随行人员正在经安克雷奇飞往马尼拉的途中。 VC-25B 25-3300 #AF83F3 AF1 VC-25A 92-9000 #ADFDF9 SAM01 VCz25A 82-8000 #ADFDF8 SAM47 @sipjack1776 @toystark6886 @LadyAstroJet pic.twitter.com/jyDtuggNOe — 约翰尼·双子座(@Borrowed7Time) 2026 年 11 月 16 日 守夜人喷气式飞机分别飞往日本冲绳岛的嘉手纳空军基地。 E-4B NAOC 73-1676 在总统马尼拉之行期间停泊在嘉手纳。信用 RODN Kadena。 pic.twitter.com/FiNBpFBsR9 — MeNMyRC (@MeNMyRC1) 2026 年 11 月 17 日 今天早些时候，所有三架 VC-25 载着​​特朗普和美国代表团其他成员离开中国。当三人开始飞越日本本土时，E-4B 从嘉手纳起飞跟随他们。
美国总统返回美国 特朗普总统及其随行人员本周在结束各种会议后正在从中国返回美国的途中： VC-25B Bridge "AF1" 25-33000 #AF83F3 VC-25A "SAM47" 82-8000 #ADFDF8 VC-25A "SAM??" 92-9000 #ADFDF9 E-4B “TRUCK55” 73-1676 #ADFEB3 KC-46A… pic.twitter.com/Yg9wYmgEGI — DefenceGeek (@DefenceGeek) 2026 年 11 月 19 日 正如开头提到的，在特朗普访问期间，E-4B 跟踪 VC-25 并在嘉手纳进行前沿部署先去菲律宾，然后去中国，这并不奇怪。这是美国总统出国旅行的标准操作程序。在特朗普五月份访华期间，飞行追踪器特别发现了类似的飞机队列。 HANK99 又名“末日飞机”(E-4B NAOC) 从内布拉斯加州奥法特空军基地飞往美国

【原文 English Original】
U.S. President Donald Trump’s recent visit to China has drawn particular attention from online flight trackers. This is in no small part due to the fact that all three of the U.S. Air Force’s current Boeing 747-based Air Force One aircraft – the two older VC-25As and the new ex-Qatari VC-25B “Bridge” jet – have supported the trip. Another militarized 747, an E-4B Nightwatch , commonly referred to as a ‘doomsday plane,’ was also spotted shadowing the group to and from Asia. While this drew a lot of attention online, including blog posts from defense-focused sites, the reality is this is absolutely standard practice. The E-4B is just another part, albeit a very unique and shy one, of the massive aerial logistics ballet that occurs whenever the President leaves the country. The Air Force currently has four E-4Bs, also known as National Airborne Operations Centers (NAOC), all based at Offutt Air Force Base in Nebraska. Based on the 747-200 model, three of these planes first entered service in the 1970s as E-4A Advanced Airborne Command Posts (AACP). Those aircraft were subsequently brought up to the E-4B NAOC standard in the 1980s, and were eventually joined by a fourth example converted straight to that configuration. The jets have been continuously upgraded over the years. In addition to supporting presidential travel, the Nightwatch aircraft also regularly transport the Secretary of Defense (now also referred to as the Secretary of War) and their staff during overseas trips, among other roles. A stock picture of an E-4B Nightwatch jet. US Military The VC-25s carrying Trump and the rest of his entourage left Andrews Air Force Base just outside Washington, D.C., on November 16. An E-4B was tracked heading out from Offutt at around the same time. Trump headed first for a brief visit to the Philippines before traveling on to China. Plane spotters had a rare opportunity to see all three VC-25s parked together at Ninoy Aquino International Airport in Manila. USAF: POTUS entourage en route to Manila via Anchorage. VC-25B 25-3300 #AF83F3 AF1 VC-25A 92-9000 #ADFDF9 SAM01 VCz25A 82-8000 #ADFDF8 SAM47 @sipjack1776 @toystark6886 @LadyAstroJet pic.twitter.com/jyDtuggNOe — Johnny Gemini (@Borrowed7Time) November 16, 2026 The Nightwatch jet headed separately to Kadena Air Base on the Japanese island of Okinawa. E-4B NAOC 73-1676 bedding down at Kadena during the presidential trip to Manilla. credit RODN Kadena. pic.twitter.com/FiNBpFBsR9 — MeNMyRC (@MeNMyRC1) November 17, 2026 All three VC-25s left China carrying Trump and the rest of the U.S. delegation earlier today. As the trio began to pass over Japan’s home islands, the E-4B took off from Kadena to follow them. POTUS Returning to the US President Trump and his entourage are en-route back to the US from China after various meetings this week: VC-25B Bridge "AF1" 25-33000 #AF83F3 VC-25A "SAM47" 82-8000 #ADFDF8 VC-25A "SAM??" 92-9000 #ADFDF9 E-4B "TRUCK55" 73-1676 #ADFEB3 KC-46A… pic.twitter.com/Yg9wYmgEGI — DefenceGeek (@DefenceGeek) November 19, 2026 As mentioned at the start, the E-4B shadowing the VC-25s and being forward-deployed in Kadena during Trump’s visit to the Philippines and then China is no surprise. This is standard operating procedure for when the President of the United States travels abroad. Flight trackers notably caught a similar procession of aircraft during Trump’s trip to China back in May. HANK99 aka “The Doomsday Plane” (E-4B NAOC) is airborne from Offutt AFB, Nebraska to shadow POTUS on his trip to China. https://t.co/BBsq1tkC1E pic.twitter.com/Z3zpxBX9zy — Thenewarea51 (@thenewarea51) May 12, 2026 While the E-4Bs are nowhere near as luxurious as the VC-25As or the new VC-25B, they are just as capable of serving as airborne command posts, if not more so in many respects . They are unofficially referred to as ‘doomsday planes’ because they are specifically configured to provide the president and other senior military officials with a flying headquarters they can use for any and all duties, including directing nuclear strikes during the most serious crises. They are hardened against electromagnetic pulses caused by nuclear detonations and have the ability to stay airborne for days. Their very existence, at least one being on alert at all times to support the National Command Authority , is a critical component that underpins America’s nuclear deterrent. Even if an adversary destroys much of the country, an E-4 can remain airborne to order the counter-attack. With all this in mind, the E-4B fleet is key to so-called continuity of government plans , which are in place to make sure key elements of the federal government remain functional following an attack or a similarly serious contingency. As a prime example, President George W. Bush rode on one of the VC-25A Air Force One aircraft in the immediate wake of the 9/11 terrorist attacks, but there were discussions about transferring him to a Nightwatch jet . Bush ultimately decided against making the change, but an E-4B was still scrambled and orbited over Washington, D.C., for a time. This is hardly the only time a president has made use of an E-4B, or one of its predecessors, as well as command ships, as TWZ has examined in the past . September 11th, 2001 – Boeing E-4B NAOC callsign ADDIS77 scrambled from Andrews AFB. While ATC was calling them “VENUS” which is a typical callsign used at Andrews, you can hear the urgency of the pilot wanting to get airborne. The E-4 orbited over Washington DC for a while… pic.twitter.com/K61yeFY3kZ — Thenewarea51 (@thenewarea51) September 11, 2021 The aircraft got airborne assuming for safety reasons (safer in air than on the ground) and if needed would have flown to pickup the President or next in the line of succession (Continuity of government). — Thenewarea51 (@thenewarea51) September 11, 2021 Within this broader context, E-4Bs have been a key feature of overseas presidential travel for decades now, although they are the least visible of the presidential aerial armada. This massive airlift and logistics effort includes bringing in multiple examples of the presidential motorcade , Marine One helicopters , and various force protection assets . This involves many sorties by C-17 and C-5 cargo aircraft that cover many thousands of miles each. The videos below from Trump’s visit this week to the Philippines give a sense of just one portion of these options, albeit the most visible one, the vertical airlift component. US President Trump landing at Luneta. Impressive to see the extent of securing the safety of the most important human being on the planet. pic.twitter.com/gIXewN6Yz3 — Emil (@13thFool) November 18, 2026 Beyond its strategic command and control mission, having an E-4B positioned in the region the president is visiting during overseas trips offers a critical option for refuge and escape, as well as an additional backup aircraft to Air Force One, should any emergencies arise. The exact parameters for where the Nightwatch aircraft go are unknown, but would be based on what suitable airports are available and what potential threats and contingencies could arise. They are never seen at the same locations as Air Force One and are always separated by a distance of dozens of miles, at least, in friendly countries — close enough to be accessed by Marine One in an emergency — or generally in a region for more sensitive locales where such close proximity basing isn’t an option. It moves in shadow of AF1 everywhere it goes overseas, usually lands at another airport nearby. This is standard procedure going back decades. We see it every single overseas trip. Beyond it's strategic and COG function it acts as a refuge/escape if something really bad happens… https://t.co/nPhxPJOKMk — Tyler Rogoway (@Aviation_Intel) November 19, 2026 E-4Bs do not need to be airborne to act as command and control platforms and secure communications relay nodes, either. This further feeds into their continuity of government role. These are capabilities that can also be made available, if required, to assist the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) during major natural disasters or to help serve as command posts and communications nodes in other emergencies. The changing character of the Air Force One fleet could put new emphasis on the E-4Bs, as well as the replacement E-4C Survivable Airborne Operations Center (SAOC) jets the Air Force is now in the process of acquiring. Trump’s trip back from China has notably underscored a significant difference between the VC-25As and the new VC-25B Bridge aircraft, which is that the latter lacks aerial refueling capability. Two fully-outfitted VC-25Bs that Boeing is still in the process of converting for the Air Force will also not be capable of refueling in flight. The E-4Bs can refuel in flight, and the E-4Cs will be able to do so, as well. Coming back from China heading to DC, the new VC-25B Bridge Air Force One does not need to refuel in Alaska but the old VC-25As do. Tracking via @ADSBex pic.twitter.com/zhcdCaIRyy — Thenewarea51 (@thenewarea51) November 19, 2026 TWZ has previously explored the Air Force’s decision to axe the aerial refueling requirement for the VC-25B in detail. The ostensible logic is that the VC-25Bs are based on newer 747-8i aircraft with more capable and fuel-efficient engines than the aging 747-200-based VC-25As. The new aircraft are, as a result, capable of longer unrefueled flights, though maximum range requirements were also watered down . At the same time, in-flight refueling allows the VC-25As ( as well as the E-4Bs ) to remain aloft for days at a time. This, in turn, could be critical in a major crisis where access to secure airfields might be limited, if not completely unavailable, for a prolonged period of time. An E-4B links up with a KC-135 aerial refueling tanker. USAF The  VC-25B Bridge jet has prompted a whole new array of operational security questions, which TWZ was calling attention to even before the decision was formally made to outfit it for presidential use. The circumstances of Trump’s return from the NATO summit in Turkey in July had prompted a further flurry of reports about whether the modified, Qatari-gifted jet lacked sufficient defensive features and other capabilities in line with the existing VC-25As. The President had flown to Turkey on the Bridge jet, but was reportedly covertly moved between other aircraft on the way back. This was said to have been done as a security precaution amid then-escalating fighting with Iran . A stock picture of the VC-25B Bridge aircraft seen at the time of its official unveiling. USAF President Trump subsequently downplayed the series of events, but said that the Bridge aircraft would be sent to have its capabilities “maxed out.” The White House confirmed that the jet would receive “additional upgrades and enhancements,” but did not elaborate. It is unclear how the aircraft’s configuration has changed in the ensuing months. It is worth noting here that the upgrades in question would have to be limited to defensive systems. The Bridge aircraft could also have entered service without certain communications and networking capabilities found on the VC-25As. Another way to mitigate any such limitations could be to have a VC-25A or an E-4B operating closely enough to establish a line-of-sight data connection relatively quickly so it can leverage the better-equipped aircraft’s communications systems if needed. As an aside, Trump arrived in China aboard the Bridge aircraft and was seen boarding it to head back to the United States. Reporters onboard had their phones taken away during the return flight for still unexplained security reasons. Fox News has reported that the president is aiming to set a record for the longest continuous flight for an Air Force One aircraft. At the time of writing, its unclear whether the president has touched back down anywhere publicly since leaving Shenzhen. Air Force One is about to take off. Press has had their phones confiscated for security reasons. pic.twitter.com/2UkCDekUma — Andrew Leyden (@PenguinSix) November 19, 2026 NOW: Air Force One is setting a new endurance record on the way home from China. In an exclusive chat with @aishahhasnie , President Trump says his trip back to Washington will be the longest continuous flight in Air Force One history. President Trump says he will discuss the… pic.twitter.com/xn25uSkzYZ — Fox News (@FoxNews) November 19, 2026 Where the E-4B is now is also unclear, but it was last tracked continuing along a path shadowing behind Air Force One, where one would expect to see it.
