Alex Fong breaks Hong Kong-Macau swim record in charity challenge | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 22 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Alex Fong breaks Hong Kong-Macau swim record in charity challenge
Former Olympic swimmer Alex Fong Lik-sun completed a 35-kilometre solo charity swim from Hong Kong to Macau on Saturday, setting a new speed record of 8 hours, 37 minutes and 24 seconds. The event raised over HK$6 million toward a HK$10 million goal to fund sports training for underprivileged childr
Former Hong Kong Olympic swimmer Alex Fong Lik-sun completed an epic 35-kilometre charity swim across open waters from Hong Kong to Macau on Saturday, setting a new speed record in the process. Organised by InspiringHK Sports Foundation, the challenge raised over HK$6 million by midday toward its HK$10 million goal to fund sports training for underprivileged children and youth with special educational needs.
Fong dove into the water alone from Kai Yik Kok on Lantau Island at 8.53am and reached the finish line in 8 hours, 37 minutes and 24 seconds — roughly 20 minutes faster than anticipated. Organisers noted that the solo crossing was governed by stringent open-water swimming rules. Throughout the entire 35-kilometre journey spanning Hong Kong waters, the Pearl River Estuary and Macau waters, the 46-year-old athlete was prohibited from boarding support vessels, holding onto any objects to rest, or wearing wetsuits, thermal gear or flotation aids.
Equipped with only a swimsuit, swim cap and goggles, Fong had to battle strong deep-sea currents, navigate busy shipping lanes and endure cold water temperatures relying purely on physical stamina and mental grit. Before setting off, Fong was cheered on at the pier by friends and relatives, including his wife Maple Yip — whom he joyfully announced on Friday is pregnant with their second child — and their daughter Isla, who had prepared a special breakfast for him earlier that morning.
Fong's younger brother, InspiringHK Sports Foundation board chairperson William Fong, also boarded an escort vessel to accompany and watch over him throughout the entire sea crossing. Ahead of the swim, Fong remarked that while months of preparation had been gruelling and sea conditions remained unpredictable, thinking of his family and the children awaiting resources on the other side kept him determined to push through.
Following his open-water feat, Fong is scheduled to make an appearance this evening at a star-studded charity concert he initiated to celebrate the Hong Kong-Macau crossing. The lineup features a wide roster of performers from both cities, including Nancy Wu, Justin Lo, Elanne Kong, Bob Lam, Wilfred Lau, Terence Siufay, Vivian Chan, Wan Kwong, German Ku, Kiri T, Gordon Flanders and the band DAZE IN WHITE.

summary: 浪漫战士退役；沙田周日举行香港冠军颁奖典礼 |中国劳工布告栏 2026 年 11 月 22 日星期日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 浪漫战士退休；沙田周日为香港冠军颁奖的“浪漫战士”，世界上收入最高的赛马，两届香港年度最佳马匹，已经退役。香港赛马会将于11月22日假沙田马场举行退役仪式。冠军将在 12 月 13 日最后一场比赛后启程前往澳大利亚。 2026 年 11 月 21 日 21:13 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 22 日 04:26 · 阅读时间 2 分钟
content:
浪漫战士退役；沙田周日举行香港冠军颁奖典礼 |中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 22 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
浪漫战士退役；沙田周日举行香港冠军颁奖典礼
世界收入最高的赛马、两届香港年度最佳赛马“浪漫战士”已经退役。香港赛马会将于11月22日假沙田马场举行退役仪式。冠军将在 12 月 13 日最后一场比赛后启程前往澳大利亚。
2026 年 11 月 21 日 21:13 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 22 日 04:26 · 阅读时间 2 分钟
世界上有史以来收入最高的赛马、两届香港年度最佳赛马“浪漫勇士”已经退役，结束了辉煌的职业生涯。 “浪漫战士”是唯一一匹在香港、中国、澳大利亚、日本和迪拜四个赛马管辖区赢得第一组比赛冠军的马匹，将于 11 月 22 日（星期日）在沙田马场举行的香港赛马会退役仪式上接受表彰。
纵观其赛马生涯，“浪漫战士”共夺得15场一级赛胜利，为香港训练马中最多的，并赚取超过2.88亿港元的奖金，刷新全球盈利纪录。除了在本土取得的成功之外，他还在不同气候、赛道布局、时区和场地的海外取得了里程碑式的胜利。
2023年，他成为澳大利亚第一位在香港训练的考克斯板甲组冠军，并于2024年在日本安田记念赛中夺冠。 2025年，在中东历时近四个月的海外征战中，他在迪拜杰贝尔哈塔一级赛中夺冠，并在迈丹赛马场创造了新的赛道纪录。
老板刘作强表示，“浪漫勇士”的成绩展现了香港赛马的世界级水平，并巩固了香港的国际地位。刘解释说，他选择“浪漫”这个名字是为了反映对浪漫退休生活的希望，而“勇士”这个名字是为了体现这匹马无所畏惧的性格——他觉得冠军满足了这些品质，同时巩固了他作为香港最伟大赛马的地位。刘还表示，希望车迷们看到浪漫战士的绿松石色和绿色倒三角赛车颜色时，会记住他，并继续支持本地赛车。
练马师岑丹尼 (Danny Shum) 在拍卖会上发现了这匹香港国际拍卖会的毕业生，并立即被他的外表所震撼，称赞这匹马在严苛环境中表现出的坚定不移的动力和适应能力。沉向洋形容《浪漫战士》是战士中的战士，他的决心和拼搏精神体现了香港精神。
岑和刘均表示依依不舍地告别冠军。浪漫战士将于周日在沙田举行的退休仪式上与他的关系人一起出席，向支持者致意并感谢他们的支持，然后于 12 月 13 日（浪琴表香港国际赛事日）在香港最后一次公开露面，然后前往澳大利亚开始退休生活。

Romantic Warrior retires; Sha Tin to honour Hong Kong champion on Sunday | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 22 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Romantic Warrior retires; Sha Tin to honour Hong Kong champion on Sunday
Romantic Warrior, the world's highest-earning racehorse and two-time Hong Kong Horse of the Year, has retired. The Hong Kong Jockey Club will hold a retirement ceremony at Sha Tin Racecourse on 22 November. The champion will leave for Australia after a final appearance on 13 December.
21 Nov 2026 at 21:13 HKT · updated 22 Nov, 04:26 · 2 min read
Romantic Warrior, the world's highest-earning racehorse of all time and two-time Hong Kong Horse of the Year, has retired from racing, bringing a decorated career to a close. The only Hong Kong-trained horse to win Group 1 races across four racing jurisdictions—Hong Kong, China, Australia, Japan, and Dubai—Romantic Warrior will be honoured at a Hong Kong Jockey Club retirement ceremony at Sha Tin Racecourse on Sunday, 22 November.
Across his racing career, Romantic Warrior captured 15 Group 1 victories, the most by any Hong Kong-trained horse, and earned more than HK$288 million in prize money to claim the all-time global earnings record. Beyond his home-soil success, he delivered landmark overseas triumphs in varying climates, track layouts, time zones, and fields.
In 2023, he became the first Hong Kong-trained winner of Australia's Group 1 Cox Plate, followed in 2024 by a victory in Japan's Yasuda Kinen. In 2025, during an overseas campaign in the Middle East lasting nearly four months, he won the Group 1 Jebel Hatta in Dubai and set a new track record at Meydan Racecourse.
Owner Peter Lau said that Romantic Warrior's accomplishments showcased the world-class standard of Hong Kong racing and strengthened the city's standing internationally. Lau explained that he chose the name "Romantic" to reflect hopes for a romantic retirement and "Warrior" to capture the horse's fearless character—qualities he feels the champion fulfilled while cementing his status as the greatest racehorse Hong Kong has produced. Lau also expressed hope that fans will remember Romantic Warrior whenever they see his turquoise and green inverted-triangle racing colours and continue supporting local racing.
Trainer Danny Shum, who spotted the Hong Kong International Sale graduate at the sale and was struck right away by his physical presence, praised the horse's unwavering drive and resilience across demanding environments. Shum described Romantic Warrior as a warrior among warriors whose determination and fighting spirit embodied the Hong Kong spirit.
Both Shum and Lau expressed reluctance at saying goodbye to the champion. Romantic Warrior will appear with his connections at Sunday's retirement ceremony at Sha Tin to greet supporters and express appreciation for their backing, before making his final public appearance in Hong Kong on 13 December—LONGINES Hong Kong International Races day—ahead of heading to Australia to begin his retirement.

content:
2026年香港海事周圆满落幕，出席人数创历史新高，艺术集装箱奖项获奖中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 22 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
2026年香港海事周圆满结束，出席人数创历史新高，艺术集装箱奖项获奖
香港海事周2026于11月21日以艺术集装箱绘画比赛及学员嘉许仪式结束。交通部长表示，参与人数可能达到 20,000 人，高于去年的 18,000 人。宣布了八项新举措，以提高港口的弹性和货物吞吐量。
2026年香港海事周于11月21日在香港海事博物馆举行联合颁奖典礼，其中包括「艺术货柜航行」绘画比赛及杰出海事甲板及轮机学员嘉许计划。运输及物流局局长在活动上发表主旨演讲。
国务卿在仪式上致辞时指出，为期7天的活动现已进入第十个年头，吸引了80多个组织举办了60多项活动。虽然参与人数仍在统计中，但他表示，初步估计出席人数可能会超过去年的 18,000 人，达到近 20,000 人。 “这次最后一天的活动特别有意义，”他补充道。
艺术容器大赛精选了初级组、二级组和公开组的获奖作品，与其他入围作品一起在博物馆的户外展览区展示。局长重点介绍了多项体现香港特色的设计，包括麻将牌、红白蓝袋子、传统街景、冰屋地砖、点心和海鲜等图案。一个集装箱将香港与多条航线连接起来，形成星空形象，局长形容这是“航海的浪漫”。
在海事周期间，今年的主题是通过伙伴港口建立信任并通过多元化增强港口的韧性，宣布了八项成果。局长表示，这些不仅仅是签署谅解备忘录，旨在“增加货运量、增加价值”，并加强香港全球航运、物流和航空供应链的协同效应。
出席典礼的嘉宾包括立法会议员兼人力资源发展委员会委员林明峰、香港海事及港务局人力资源发展委员会主席古威灵、海事处处长黄世发、香港海事博物馆主席宋泽明、学员嘉许计划工作小组主席索马桑达奈尔船长、东方海外货柜航运有限公司陈康妮及现代货箱码头有限公司辉耀明等。

Sunday, 22 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
HK Maritime Week 2026 concludes with record attendance, art container awards
Hong Kong's Maritime Week 2026 ended on 21 November with an art container painting competition and a cadet recognition ceremony. Transport Secretary said participation likely reached 20,000, up from 18,000 last year. Eight new initiatives were announced to boost port resilience and cargo throughput.
Hong Kong's Maritime Week 2026 concluded on 21 November with a joint award ceremony at the Hong Kong Maritime Museum, featuring the "Art Container Voyage" painting competition and the Outstanding Marine Deck and Engine Cadet Recognition Scheme. The Secretary for Transport and Logistics delivered the keynote speech at the event.
Speaking at the ceremony, the Secretary noted that the seven-day event, now in its tenth year, had drawn more than 80 organisations organising over 60 activities. While participation numbers were still being tallied, he said initial estimates suggested attendance had likely surpassed last year's 18,000 to reach nearly 20,000. "This final-day event is particularly meaningful," he added.
The art container competition featured winning entries from primary, secondary and open categories, displayed alongside other shortlisted works in an outdoor exhibition area at the museum. The Secretary highlighted several designs that captured Hong Kong's character, including patterns resembling mahjong tiles, red-white-blue bags, traditional street scenes, ice-house floor tiles, dim sum and seafood. One container linked Hong Kong with various shipping routes to form a starry sky image, which the Secretary described as evoking "the romance of navigation".
During Maritime Week, eight outcomes were announced under this year's theme of building trust through partner ports and enhancing port resilience through diversification. The Secretary said these went beyond signing memoranda of understanding, aiming to "increase cargo volume, increase value" and strengthen synergies across Hong Kong's global shipping, logistics and aviation supply chains.
The ceremony was attended by Legislative Council member and Human Resources Development Committee member Lam Ming-fung, Wellington Koo, chairman of the Hong Kong Maritime and Port Authority's Human Resources Development Committee, Maritime Department Director Wong Sai-fat, Hong Kong Maritime Museum chairman Richard Sung, Captain Somasundar Nair, chairman of the Cadet Recognition Scheme working group, Connie Chan of Orient Overseas Container Line and Frank Fai of Modern Terminals.

zh_title: 友邦保险香港及澳门推出Omni Healthcare Circle以应对成本上升
summary: 友邦保险香港及澳门推出Omni Healthcare Circle以应对成本上升|中国劳工公告牌 星期日, 2026 年 11 月 22 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 友邦保险香港及澳门推出 Omni Healthcare Circle 以应对不断上升的成本 友邦香港及澳门在其 2026 年医疗融资峰会上推出 Omni Healthcare Circle，这是一种与私人医疗服务提供者合作的模式，旨在提高护理质量和可持续性。该举措旨在解决 2019 年至 2023 年私人医疗保险支出增长 60% 的问题，并且 AIA 香港和澳门举办的 Healthc 支出增长了 68%
content:
友邦保险香港及澳门推出Omni Healthcare Circle以应对成本上升|中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 22 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
友邦保险香港及澳门推出Omni Healthcare Circle以应对成本上升
友邦保险香港及澳门在其 2026 年医疗保健融资峰会上推出了 Omni Healthcare Circle，这是一种与私人提供商的合作模式，旨在提高护理质量和可持续性。该举措旨在解决从 2019 年到 2023 年私人医疗保险支出增长 60% 的问题，以及 2023 年私人医疗保险支出增长 68% 的问题。
友邦保险香港及澳门于11月21日举办了2026年医疗保健融资峰会，汇聚了政府官员、监管机构、医疗保健提供者、学者、财务规划师和行业利益相关者，以促进跨界别合作。会上，该保险公司推出了 Omni Healthcare Circle，这是一种与私营医疗保健提供商的新合作模式，旨在提高护理质量，鼓励适当和有效地利用医疗资源，并支持香港医疗保健系统的长期可持续发展。
高峰会上的讲者包括卫生局局长卢松茂、保险业监管局行政总裁张云清及卫生局常任秘书长陈伟强，他们就香港医疗生态系统的未来方向分享了看法。友邦保险集团首席执行官兼总裁李源祥也向与会者发表讲话，重申该集团致力于支持该市医疗保健可持续发展的承诺。
此次聚会正值香港医疗融资压力日益加大之际。由香港保险业联会委托、理大专业进修学院安老及医疗管理研究中心进行的研究发现，2019年至2023年间，私人医疗保险支出增加逾60%，而同期住院索赔频率则增加68%。
友邦保险香港及澳门行政总裁Alger Fung指出，随着预期寿命的延长和医疗需求的发展，保险公司、医疗保健提供者和其他利益相关者在保持优质医疗保健可及且负担得起方面发挥着至关重要的作用。他补充说，峰会旨在围绕共同的挑战将生态系统的不同部分联合起来，并通过更密切的提供商合作和医疗融资创新推动有意义的进展。
Omni Healthcare Circle 将临床专业知识与医疗保健利用和患者旅程的见解相结合，帮助患者导航治疗路径并更清楚地预测成本。该计划侧重于三个核心领域：通过将患者与符合医学进步和临床卓越研究所的临床指南以及公认的国际标准的循证护理途径联系起来，扩大获得高质量和适当护理的机会；通过有关护理质量、结果和效率的更清晰、更客观的信息，为患者提供更大的透明度和信心；通过在患者治疗过程的早期将医疗服务提供者和 AIA 聚集在一起，为治疗计划和预期费用提供更大的确定性，同时简化行政流程，从而支持及时的治疗和更顺畅的体验。
香港中文大学医院及香港鹰阁医院是首批与友邦保险探索该模式的私营医疗机构，友邦保险仍愿意与更多志同道合的私人专业人士合作

Sunday, 22 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
AIA Hong Kong & Macau launches Omni Healthcare Circle to tackle rising costs
AIA Hong Kong & Macau launched the Omni Healthcare Circle at its Healthcare Financing Summit 2026, a partnership model with private providers to improve care quality and sustainability. The initiative addresses a 60 per cent rise in private medical insurance spending from 2019 to 2023 and a 68 per c
AIA Hong Kong & Macau hosted its Healthcare Financing Summit 2026 on 21 November, bringing together government officials, regulators, healthcare providers, academics, financial planners and industry stakeholders to advance cross-sector collaboration. At the event, the insurer unveiled the Omni Healthcare Circle, a new partnership model with private healthcare providers designed to improve care quality, encourage appropriate and efficient use of medical resources, and support the long-term sustainability of Hong Kong's healthcare system.
Speakers at the summit included Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau, Insurance Authority Chief Executive Officer Clement Cheung Wan-ching, and Permanent Secretary for Health Thomas Chan, who shared views on the future direction of Hong Kong's healthcare ecosystem. AIA Group Chief Executive and President Lee Yuan Siong also addressed attendees, reaffirming the group's commitment to supporting the sustainable development of healthcare in the city.
The gathering comes amid mounting pressure on healthcare financing in Hong Kong. Research commissioned by the Hong Kong Federation of Insurers and conducted by the Centre for Ageing and Healthcare Management Research at PolyU CPCE found that private medical insurance spending rose by more than 60 per cent between 2019 and 2023, while inpatient claim frequency climbed by 68 per cent over the same period.
AIA Hong Kong & Macau Chief Executive Officer Alger Fung noted that insurers, healthcare providers and other stakeholders each play a vital role in keeping quality healthcare accessible and affordable as life expectancy rises and medical needs evolve. He added that the summit aims to unite different parts of the ecosystem around shared challenges and drive meaningful progress through closer provider collaboration and healthcare financing innovation.
The Omni Healthcare Circle pairs clinical expertise with insights into healthcare utilisation and patient journeys to help patients navigate treatment paths and anticipate costs more clearly. The initiative focuses on three core areas: broadening access to high-quality and appropriate care by connecting patients with evidence-based care pathways aligned with clinical guidelines from the Institute for Medical Advancement and Clinical Excellence and recognised international standards; giving patients greater transparency and confidence through clearer, more objective information on care quality, outcomes and efficiency; and supporting timely treatment and a smoother experience by bringing providers and AIA together earlier in the patient journey to provide greater certainty around treatment plans and expected expenses while streamlining administrative processes.
CUHK Medical Centre and Gleneagles Hospital Hong Kong are the first private healthcare institutions exploring the model with AIA, with the insurer remaining open to partnering with additional like-minded private providers in the future. Alice Liang, Chief Proposition and Healthcare Officer at AIA Hong Kong & Macau, explained that the initiative translates collaboration into practical action. She noted that both hospitals have strong ties to leading Hong Kong universities, bringing strengths in clinical care, research and innovative medical technologies that help use medical resources more efficiently while extending benefits to patients and the wider community. The summit also featured panel discussions in which leaders from healthcare, insurance and related fields exchanged views on applying the Omni Healthcare Circle model to foster greater transparency and more predictable patient journeys.

东北季候风周二到来，香港周中气温将下降 |中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 22 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
东北季候风周二到来，香港周中气温将下降
香港天文台周六取消了寒冷天气警告。周末气温将小幅上升，然后一股新鲜的东北季风从周二开始带来凉爽的天气，新界一些地区的最低气温将降至14摄氏度。
2026 年 11 月 21 日 18:19 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 22 日 04:24 · 阅读时间 2 分钟
香港天文台继前一天上午 11 点 15 分发布寒冷天气警告后，于 11 月 21 日星期六早上 6 点取消了寒冷天气警告。虽然预计未来两天气温将小幅上升，但周二到来的东北季风将引发全港周中气温显着下降。
天文台表示，一股清新至强劲的偏东气流将在未来数日影响华南沿岸，带来云量增加及气温轻微上升。周六下午，预计天气基本晴朗，非常干燥，吹中度至清新的东北风，今晚逐渐转为多云。周日天气会比较温暖，天气主要为多云，气温在 19 至 22 摄氏度之间，当天晚些时候还会有一到两场小雨。周一气温将进一步攀升，最高可达 24 度，最低可达 21 度，天空多云，有阵雨。
天文台预计东北季候风将于周二抵达华南沿岸，为下周中带来凉爽天气及几阵骤雨。周二最低气温将降至 18 度，比周一白天最高气温下降 6 度。周三寒冷将加剧，气温在 16 至 20 度之间波动，天空多云，偶尔有阵雨，早晚凉爽。
自动区域预报显示，新界在周中寒流期间将明显凉爽。周二，该地区大部分地区的气温将在 16 至 17 度左右，周三将进一步下降，预计上水和天水围的气温将降至 15 度，打鼓岭的气温可能低至 14 度。
随着广东沿海季风略有减弱，预计情况将在下周末有所改善。到下周六（11 月 28 日），白天天气将基本晴朗且干燥，最高气温将回升至 26 度，随后，11 月 29 日（周日）将出现晴朗天气，气温将在 19 至 24 度之间。

Hong Kong temperatures to dip midweek as northeast monsoon arrives Tuesday
The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the cold weather warning on Saturday. Temperatures will rise slightly over the weekend before a fresh northeast monsoon brings cooler weather from Tuesday, with lows dropping to 14 degrees Celsius in some New Territories areas.
21 Nov 2026 at 18:19 HKT · updated 22 Nov, 04:24 · 2 min read
The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the cold weather warning at 6am on Saturday, 21 November, after issuing it the previous morning at 11.15am. While temperatures are expected to edge upward over the next two days, a fresh northeast monsoon arriving on Tuesday will trigger a notable midweek temperature drop across the territory.
According to the Observatory, a fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China over the next couple of days, bringing increased cloud cover and a slight rise in temperatures. For Saturday afternoon, conditions are forecast to be mainly fine and very dry with moderate to fresh northeasterly winds, gradually turning cloudier tonight. Sunday will be warmer, with temperatures ranging between 19 and 22 degrees Celsius under mainly cloudy skies, accompanied by one or two light rain patches later in the day. Temperatures will climb further on Monday, reaching a high of 24 degrees and a low of 21 degrees with cloudy skies and isolated showers.
The Observatory expects a northeast monsoon to reach the south China coast on Tuesday, bringing cooler weather and a few showers through the middle of next week. Tuesday's minimum temperature will dip to 18 degrees, representing a six-degree drop from Monday's daytime high. The chill will deepen on Wednesday, with temperatures fluctuating between 16 and 20 degrees alongside cloudy skies, occasional showers, and cool mornings and evenings.
Automated regional forecasts indicate that the New Territories will be noticeably cooler during the midweek cold spell. Most areas across the region will see temperatures around 16 to 17 degrees on Tuesday before dropping another degree on Wednesday, when Sheung Shui and Tin Shui Wai are forecast to fall to 15 degrees and Ta Kwu Ling could dip as low as 14 degrees.
Conditions are expected to improve toward the end of next week as the monsoon moderates slightly over the Guangdong coast. By next Saturday, 28 November, skies will become mainly fine and dry during the day with highs climbing back to 26 degrees, followed by sunny intervals and temperatures between 19 and 24 degrees on Sunday, 29 November.

content:
香港通过新工业园和贸易指南推动模块化建设中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 22 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港通过新工业园和贸易指南推动模块化建设
香港发展局局长表示，模块化建筑（MiC）已被超过 150 个项目采用。政府正在新界北部预留30公顷土地兴建先进建筑工业园，并推出制造商认证计划和跨境贸易
香港发展局局长叶国雄表示，政府正在推动高效建筑，其中模块化集成建筑（MiC）是过去十年最引人注目的成就之一。叶说，超过150个公私营项目已采用MiC，涵盖员工宿舍、公共房屋、私人住宅及大学宿舍。
叶在模块化建筑国际会议开幕礼上表示，政府已宣布计划在新界北部预留30公顷土地兴建大型先进建筑工业园。该园区旨在在香港及其他地区推广高端建筑技术。
叶表示，发展局已实施一系列措施加强MiC供应链。其中包括启动MiC制造商认证计划、与内地当局合作发布《粤港MiC模块化建筑跨境贸易指南》以及与广东省住房和城乡建设厅签署合作协议。
该协议旨在共同提升两地工程建设标准，通过协同工作机制，协调指导粤港澳大湾区建设标准制定。
发展局在社交媒体上表示，叶先生亦见证香港大学在发展局及香港建筑科技学会的支持下，发布首个MiC标准及MiC指南。叶先生称该出版物为制定大湾区 MiC 标准奠定了基础。

Hong Kong pushes modular construction with new industry park, trade guide | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 22 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong pushes modular construction with new industry park, trade guide
Hong Kong's Development Bureau chief says modular construction (MiC) has been adopted by over 150 projects. The government is reserving 30 hectares in the Northern New Territories for an advanced construction industry park, and has launched a manufacturer accreditation scheme and a cross-border trad
Hong Kong's Development Bureau chief Arion Ip said the government is pushing efficient construction, with modular integrated construction (MiC) one of the most notable achievements of the past decade. More than 150 public and private projects have adopted MiC, covering staff quarters, public housing, private homes and university dormitories, Ip said.
Speaking at the opening ceremony of the Modular Building International Conference, Ip said the government has announced plans to reserve 30 hectares of land in the Northern New Territories for a large-scale advanced construction industry park. The park aims to promote high-end construction technology in Hong Kong and beyond.
Ip said the Development Bureau has implemented a series of measures to strengthen the MiC supply chain. These include launching a MiC manufacturer accreditation scheme, publishing the Guangdong-Hong Kong MiC Modular Building Cross-Border Trade Guide in collaboration with mainland authorities, and signing a cooperation agreement with the Guangdong Provincial Department of Housing and Urban-Rural Development.
The agreement aims to jointly raise engineering and construction standards in both places and, through a collaborative working mechanism, coordinate and guide the setting of construction standards for the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area.
The Development Bureau said on social media that Ip also witnessed the University of Hong Kong release the first MiC standard and MiC guide, supported by the bureau and the Hong Kong Institute of Building Technology. Ip described the publication as laying the foundation for setting Greater Bay Area MiC standards.

content:
香港政策负责人概述特区在“一国两制”全球倡议中的作用中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 22 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港政策负责人概述特区在“一国两制”全球倡议中的作用
香港特别行政区行政长官政策组负责人在11月21日的论坛上表示，香港可以利用“一国两制”优势，包括绿色债券、药品监管、人工智能治理和国际争端解决机制等，帮助推进中国的四大全球倡议。
香港特别行政区行政长官政策组负责人表示，香港可以在“一国两制”原则下发挥自身优势，为国家四大全球倡议作出贡献。 11月21日，在“中国香港专题论坛：新时代港澳管治​​与发展”上，这位官员概述了香港如何帮助落实全球发展倡议、全球安全倡议、全球文明倡议和全球治理倡议。
这位官员提到，在全球发展倡议下，财政部今年5月在香港发行了人民币计价的绿色主权债券，将中国的绿色融资安排与国际投资者联系起来。这位官员还提到了香港从三月份开始实施的新药品“一级审查”制度，以及计划中的药品监管中心，该中心旨在与国际标准保持一致并支持全球卫生界。
在全球安全倡议中，该官员强调了香港金融管理局的生成式人工智能沙箱，该沙箱允许金融机构在受控环境中测试技术和风险管理措施。这位官员指出，习近平主席在7月的世界人工智能大会上呼吁人工智能又快又稳，加强治理规则和技术标准协调。
在全球文明倡议下，该官员指出西九文化区的两个博物馆是文化交流的例子。香港故宫文化博物馆去年与多哈伊斯兰艺术博物馆合作，下个月将与巴黎吉美国家亚洲艺术博物馆合作。 M+最近与巴黎蓬皮杜中心和纽约现代艺术博物馆结成文化联盟。
对于全球治理倡议，这位官员强调了国际争端解决组织（IDRO），该组织在中央政府的支持下在香港设立了总部。 IDRO于5月记录了首个成功案例，即通过调解解决跨境海事争端。总部由旧湾仔警署改建而成，象征有分歧的各方如何通过调解找到多元化的解决方案。
这位官员表示，这些例子表明香港如何发挥自身优势，为国际合作做出贡献。这位官员还指出，在中央政府港澳事务办公室的支持下，今年7月成立的中国社会科学院港澳研究中心正在致力于构建“一国两制”的理论框架和学术话语。展望香港回归祖国30周年

Hong Kong policy chief outlines SAR role in global initiatives under 'one country, two systems' | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 22 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong policy chief outlines SAR role in global initiatives under 'one country, two systems'
The head of the Hong Kong SAR Chief Executive's Policy Unit said at a forum on 21 November that Hong Kong can help advance China's four major global initiatives by leveraging its 'one country, two systems' advantages, citing green bonds, drug regulation, AI governance and the International Dispute R
The head of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Chief Executive's Policy Unit said Hong Kong can contribute to the nation's four major global initiatives by leveraging its advantages under the 'one country, two systems' principle. Speaking at the 'China Hong Kong Thematic Forum: Governance and Development of Hong Kong and Macao in the New Era' on 21 November, the official outlined how the city can help implement the Global Development Initiative, Global Security Initiative, Global Civilisation Initiative and Global Governance Initiative.
Under the Global Development Initiative, the official cited the Ministry of Finance's issuance of renminbi-denominated green sovereign bonds in Hong Kong in May this year, which connects China's green financing arrangements with international investors. The official also mentioned Hong Kong's new 'first-tier review' system for pharmaceuticals, implemented from March, and the planned drug regulatory centre, which aims to align with international standards and support the global health community.
On the Global Security Initiative, the official highlighted the Hong Kong Monetary Authority's generative artificial intelligence sandbox, which allows financial institutions to test technology and risk management measures in a controlled environment. The official noted President Xi Jinping's call at the World AI Conference in July for AI to be both fast and stable, and for enhanced coordination of governance rules and technical standards.
Under the Global Civilisation Initiative, the official pointed to the West Kowloon Cultural District's two museums as examples of cultural exchange. The Hong Kong Palace Museum collaborated with the Museum of Islamic Art in Doha last year and will partner with the Guimet National Museum of Asian Arts in Paris next month. M+ recently formed a cultural alliance with the Centre Pompidou in Paris and the Museum of Modern Art in New York.
For the Global Governance Initiative, the official highlighted the International Dispute Resolution Organisation (IDRO), which opened its headquarters in Hong Kong with central government support. The IDRO recorded its first successful case in May, a cross-border maritime dispute resolved through mediation. The headquarters, renovated from the old Wan Chai Police Station, symbolises how parties with differences can find diverse solutions through mediation.
The official said these examples demonstrate how Hong Kong can leverage its strengths to contribute to international cooperation. The official also noted that the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences' Hong Kong and Macao Research Centre, established in July with support from the central government's Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office, is working to build a theoretical framework and academic discourse for 'one country, two systems'. Looking ahead to the 30th anniversary of Hong Kong's return to the motherland next year, the official said Hong Kong must adhere to the 'one country' foundation while leveraging 'two systems' advantages.

content:
香港选举委员会投票开始，856名候选人角逐723个议席中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 22 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港选举委员会投票开始 856名候选人角逐723个议席
香港选举委员会补选今日举行，856名候选人角逐31个界别723个议席。社会福利界的竞争最为激烈，有 25 名候选人争夺 15 个席位。五个投票站的投票时间为上午 9 点至下午 6 点。
香港选举委员会补选今天举行，856名候选人角逐31个有争议选举的界别的723个议席。据消息人士透露，大约有 5,700 人有资格在这次选举中投票。
社会福利界别竞争最为激烈，有25名候选人争夺15个席位，即平均每个席位有1.66名候选人。 700多名投票获胜者将与259名自动当选的候选人以及518名当然和提名席位的成员一起组成由1,500名成员组成的新选举委员会。
选举委员会的职责包括提名行政长官选举候选人和选举行政长官，以及提名立法会候选人和选举选举委员会界别的40名立法会议员。
全港已设立五个一般投票站，供合资格选民使用，投票时间为上午九时至下午六时。投票结束后，所有投票箱将运往湾仔会议展览中心的中央点票站进行点票。

Hong Kong election committee polls open with 856 candidates for 723 seats | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 22 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong election committee polls open with 856 candidates for 723 seats
Hong Kong's election committee by-election is held today with 856 candidates competing for 723 seats across 31 sectors. The social welfare sector sees the tightest race with 25 candidates for 15 seats. Polls are open from 9am to 6pm at five stations.
Hong Kong's election committee by-election is being held today, with 856 candidates competing for 723 seats across 31 sectors that require contested elections. About 5,700 people are eligible to vote in this election, according to the source.
The social welfare sector is the most competitive, with 25 candidates vying for 15 seats, meaning an average of 1.66 candidates per seat. The 700-plus winners from the vote will join 259 candidates who were automatically elected and 518 members from ex-officio and nominated seats to form the new 1,500-member election committee.
The election committee's responsibilities include nominating candidates for the chief executive election and electing the chief executive, as well as nominating legislative council candidates and electing 40 legislative council members from the election committee sector.
Five general polling stations have been set up across the territory for eligible voters, with voting hours from 9am to 6pm. After voting ends, all ballot boxes will be transported to the central counting station at the Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai for vote counting.
